prs.title: feat(cli): open effort picker from the OpenTUI footer
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The reasoning-effort tier in the OpenTUI footer status line becomes a first-class control. Clicking the tier (for example `high` or `max`) opens the existing effort picker with the displayed tier preselected; choosing a row applies it immediately and persists it. The pick is stored as `model.reasoningEffort`, and the picker removes the provider and global static overrides in writable scopes: flat `reasoning_effort`, and a nested `reasoning` object as a unit. The nested object is removed whole because its presence can suppress the configured tier; sibling keys such as `budget_tokens` are removed with it and reported in the UI. The pick clears only higher-precedence scopes, so a lower-precedence user default is preserved. Provider entries are matched by protocol, id, and the live/persisted base URL; when the match is ambiguous the picker leaves the provider untouched. The provider-array write uses the same `${VAR}` placeholder preservation as the provider-install path. Footer-opened picks are shown in the transcript but are not recorded as a typed `/effort`. A click is distinguished from a drag-select release by checking whether the renderer selection contains text, which also keeps compatibility with the selection auto-copy work. Ink is untouched.

## Why it's needed

The footer already displays the tier, so making users type `/effort` is avoidable friction. More importantly, users with a static `reasoning_effort` in provider settings currently cannot change the effective tier: the raw value is merged last and wins both at request time and after restart. The picker now leaves one authority (`model.reasoningEffort`) and removes the shadowing raw values, so the selection actually survives a restart.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Build and launch the CLI with `QWEN_TUI_RENDERER=opentui` and a model that exposes effort tiers (DeepSeek-V4.x, GPT-5.x, tiered Qwen, or a model with `capabilities.reasoning.efforts`).

Confirm the footer shows `<model> <tier>`. Click only the tier; the picker should open with that tier preselected. Click the model name or another status-line run; nothing should happen.

Pick a different tier. The footer should update, and the settings file of the scope that owns `modelProviders` should show the new `model.reasoningEffort`; any matching provider or global static effort key should be gone while unrelated sibling fields (for example `temperature`) remain. A nested `reasoning` object is removed as a unit and the dropped keys are reported. Restart; the footer and requests should keep the chosen tier.

Drag-select footer text that ends on the tier. It should copy (when selection auto-copy is present) without opening the picker. A plain click should still open it.

Toggle-only models, models without reasoning capabilities, and a displayed tier outside the model's ladder should show no click target. The footer opener is also disabled while a turn is streaming, matching `/effort`'s mid-turn admission behavior. `/effort` should behave as before.

Repeat with a custom provider key mapped through `providerProtocol`, and with a static effort stored in `model.generationConfig`; both should be cleared after the pick.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the tier in the footer is plain text; only `/effort` can change it, and a static provider `reasoning_effort` wins over the global setting.

After: the tier is clickable; the picker preselects it and persists the choice; static provider and global generation-config effort keys are removed through placeholder-safe per-path deletes; restart keeps the tier.

PTY end-to-end output (temporary `QWEN_HOME`; real OpenTUI renderer with SGR mouse input):

```text
phase 1: clicking 'max' at row=39 col=31
phase 1 footer: '  DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (Local) high · /home/mike/github/qwen-code · v0.28.0'
phase 1 settings: model.reasoningEffort='high' extra_body=None
phase 2 footer after restart: '  DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (Local) high · /home/mike/github/qwen-code · v0.28.0'
--- PASS: footer pick persists to settings.json and survives restart ---
```

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment

Local source build with the bundled Bun 1.4.4 runtime for OpenTUI; TypeScript build under Node 22.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the feature writes settings. Provider-array writes preserve `${VAR}` placeholders and use `throwOnWriteFailure`; ambiguous provider matches skip the static rewrite rather than touching a sibling. A nested `reasoning` object with siblings is removed wholesale so it cannot suppress the tier, and the dropped keys are reported. The pick clears only higher-precedence scopes, preserving a lower-precedence user default.
- Not validated / out of scope: macOS/Windows manual runs; System/SystemDefaults-owned static effort (operator config wins and is not writable); provider-specific budget knobs (`thinking_budget`, `budget_tokens`, `thinkingLevel`); provider ids containing `.`; selection-copy visually re-checked after the selection-clipboard PR lands.
- A real temporary settings file test covers the JSONC per-path delete, nested whole-object removal, sibling preservation, and `${VAR}` placeholder retention without writing the resolved secret.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Ink is unchanged. A provider static effort key is intentionally removed when the picker is used, because it is the value being replaced. The footer opener is disabled while a turn is streaming.

Design docs: [English](https://github.com/MikeWang0316tw/qwen-code/blob/feat/opentui-clickable-effort/docs/design/2026-11-19-opentui-footer-effort-picker.md) | [简体中文](https://github.com/MikeWang0316tw/qwen-code/blob/feat/opentui-clickable-effort/docs/design/2026-11-19-opentui-footer-effort-picker.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

N/A

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做什么

OpenTUI footer 状态列中的 reasoning effort tier 现在是一个正式的控制入口。点击 tier（例如 `high` 或 `max`）会打开既有的 effort picker，并预选 footer 显示的 tier；选择后立即套用并持久化。选择会存成 `model.reasoningEffort`，同时移除 writable scope 中的 provider/global 静态覆写：flat `reasoning_effort`，以及整个 nested `reasoning` 对象（该对象存在就可能压制 configured tier；`budget_tokens` 等兄弟键会一并移除并在 UI 提示）。只清优先级更高的 scope，保留较低优先级的 User 预设。Provider entry 以 protocol、id 与 live/persisted base URL 定位；若无法唯一匹配，就不动 provider。Provider array 写入沿用 provider-install 路径的 `${VAR}` placeholder 保留逻辑。Footer 开启的选择会显示在 transcript，但不会记录成使用者输入的 `/effort`。点击与拖曳选取放开的区别，是检查 renderer 选取是否含文字，这也兼容 selection auto-copy。Ink 完全不变。

## 为什么需要

Footer 已经显示 tier，要求使用者再输入 `/effort` 是不必要的摩擦。更重要的是，provider 设定里若有静态 `reasoning_effort`，目前无法改变实际 tier：raw 值最后合并，在请求时与重新启动后都会胜出。Picker 现在只留下一个权威来源（`model.reasoningEffort`），并移除会覆盖它的 raw 值，因此选择真的能跨重新启动生效。

## 审查者测试计划

### 如何验证

用 `QWEN_TUI_RENDERER=opentui` 启动 build 后的 CLI，并使用有 effort tier 的模型（DeepSeek-V4.x、GPT-5.x、tiered Qwen，或宣告 `capabilities.reasoning.efforts` 的模型）。

确认 footer 显示 `<model> <tier>`。只点击 tier；picker 应打开并预选该 tier。点击模型名称或其他 status-line 内容应没有反应。

选择不同 tier。Footer 应更新，拥有 `modelProviders` 的 scope 的 settings 档应出现新的 `model.reasoningEffort`；对应的 provider 或全域静态 effort key 应消失，不相关的兄弟字段（例如 `temperature`）保留。Nested `reasoning` 对象会整包移除，被丢弃的 key 会在 UI 提示。重新启动后，footer 与请求应保持新 tier。

拖曳选取 footer 文字并在 tier 上放开。若有 selection auto-copy，应复制但不打开 picker；单纯点击仍应打开。

Toggle-only、没有 reasoning 能力的模型，以及显示 tier 不在模型档位列表内的情况，都不应有可点目标。串流进行中 footer 入口也会关闭，与 `/effort` 的 mid-turn 准入行为一致。`/effort` 行为应维持不变。

再用 `providerProtocol` 映射的自订 provider key，以及存放在 `model.generationConfig` 的静态 effort 各测一次；选择后都应被清除。

### 证据（Before & After）

Before：footer 的 tier 只是纯文字；只能靠 `/effort` 改变，且 provider 静态 `reasoning_effort` 会盖过全域设定。

After：tier 可点击；picker 预选并持久化选择；provider 与 global generation-config 的静态 effort key 会以保留 placeholder 的逐路径 delete 移除；重新启动仍保持 tier。

PTY 端到端输出（暂存 `QWEN_HOME`；真实 OpenTUI renderer 搭配 SGR 鼠标输入）：

```text
phase 1: clicking 'max' at row=39 col=31
phase 1 footer: '  DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (Local) high · /home/mike/github/qwen-code · v0.28.0'
phase 1 settings: model.reasoningEffort='high' extra_body=None
phase 2 footer after restart: '  DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (Local) high · /home/mike/github/qwen-code · v0.28.0'
--- PASS: footer pick persists to settings.json and survives restart ---
```

### 测试平台

Linux ✅；macOS ⚠️；Windows ⚠️。

### 环境

OpenTUI 使用内附 Bun 1.4.4 的本机 source build；TypeScript build 使用 Node 22。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：本功能会写 settings。Provider array 写入会保留 `${VAR}` placeholder 并使用 `throwOnWriteFailure`；provider 匹配有歧义时会跳过静态改写，不动 sibling。Nested `reasoning` 有兄弟键时会整包移除，避免压制 tier，并在 UI 提示被丢弃的 key。只清优先级更高的 scope，保留较低优先级的 User 预设。
- 未验证／不在范围：macOS/Windows 手动测试；System/SystemDefaults 拥有的静态 effort（operator 设定优先且不可写）；provider 专属 budget knob（`thinking_budget`、`budget_tokens`、`thinkingLevel`）；含 `.` 的 provider id；selection-clipboard PR 合并后需再做一次选取复制的视觉确认。
- 已用真实临时 settings 档测试覆盖 JSONC 逐路径删除、nested 整包移除、兄弟键保留，以及 `${VAR}` placeholder 保留且不写入展开后的密钥。
- 破坏性变更／迁移：无。Ink 不变。使用 picker 时会刻意移除 provider 静态 effort key，因为它正是要被替换的值。串流进行中 footer 入口会关闭。

设计文件：[English](https://github.com/MikeWang0316tw/qwen-code/blob/feat/opentui-clickable-effort/docs/design/2026-11-19-opentui-footer-effort-picker.md) | [简体中文](https://github.com/MikeWang0316tw/qwen-code/blob/feat/opentui-clickable-effort/docs/design/2026-11-19-opentui-footer-effort-picker.zh-CN.md)

prs.title: fix(agents): reject incompatible Host replacements
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Refuses an Agent Host replacement when its resulting set of bound Hosts cannot offer an affected agent's explicitly pinned program. It reports affected agent IDs before changing persistent state, preserves pins, and permits replacement when a compatible surviving Host still satisfies the pin. Interrupted replacements are checked again even after bindings have moved to the staged identity.

Enrollment errors distinguish a known unregistered secret from an already enrolled staged secret. Known refusals retain the existing status/error contract for older clients and add actionable detail for current clients; staged conflicts preserve the enrolled secret. Current clients display the detail while retaining secret cleanup and earlier-identity restoration semantics.

## Why it's needed

Host replacement previously preserved a program pin while moving the agent onto Hosts that might not offer it. The inspected pickup path skips an unavailable pinned program, so this configuration can strand queued work without notifying the owner. Direct binding updates already reject an unsupported pin; replacement needs equivalent compatibility admission without silently selecting another program or breaking enrollment recovery.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Pin an agent to Claude on its only Host, then attempt replacement with a Qwen-only Host. Expect refusal, affected IDs and corrective advice, with both registry and roster unchanged and the pin preserved. An invalid token must receive a generic refusal without agent details.
- Correct the replacement's program declarations and retry the same unexpired enrollment token. Expect successful replacement and an unchanged pin. Also verify that a Qwen-only replacement succeeds when a surviving bound Host offers Claude, while a surviving v2 unavailable probe does not count as support.
- Exercise interrupted enrollment and secret rotation. A known unregistered refusal must clean up the candidate secret or restore the earlier enrolled secret; an enrolled staged-secret conflict must preserve that secret. Retrying after the roster committed must still check program compatibility and reuse the staged Host ID.

Completed local validation: `npm run build`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run bundle`, targeted ESLint and Prettier all passed. From `packages/core`, `npx vitest run src/agents/workspace-agents/store.test.ts --coverage.enabled=false` passed 46 tests. From `packages/cli`, `npx vitest run src/serve/routes/agent-hosts.test.ts src/serve/agent-host-client.test.ts --coverage.enabled=false` passed 123 tests. An independent test-engineer verified the local bundle through real daemon HTTP routes. Two independent design audit rounds were incorporated, and the subsequent implementation review reported “No findings.”

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the global `qwen 0.27.3` HTTP reproduction returned `replacementStatus: 201` for a Qwen-only replacement of a Claude-pinned agent, preserving the pin on the incompatible new binding. A current-source script reproduced the same invalid admission.

After: the local bundle daemon recorded `conflictStatus: 401` with affected IDs and corrective detail, `registryAndRosterBytesUnchanged: true`, and `sameTokenAndSecretRetryStatus: 201` after compatible declarations. The compatible-surviving-Host case recorded `replacementStatus: 201` with the pin and surviving binding preserved. No screenshots or recordings were captured; HTTP observations are the before/after evidence. Actual indefinitely queued work and remote program execution were not exercised.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ tested — build, typecheck, bundle, 169 focused tests and local daemon HTTP verification |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment (optional)

macOS; Node.js `v22.18.0`; pnpm `11.24.0`; isolated local daemon using `node dist/cli.js`. The global reproduction used `qwen 0.27.3`. Initial build failure from installed `diff 7.0.0` versus required `^8.0.3` was repaired with a frozen-lockfile dependency synchronization and postinstall; manifests and lockfile were unchanged. An early missing-dist test guard stopped one attempt during rebuilding; final tests ran with completed prerequisites and settled dependencies. Unrelated build warnings remain.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: incompatible replacements now require operator correction. Admission checks available declarations/probes, so it does not guarantee a Host is online or that a later heartbeat still reports the program available. Existing explicit pins are never dropped automatically.
- Not validated / out of scope: Linux/Windows, CI, actual queued-run liveness, remote Claude/Codex execution, full mixed-version processes and real daemon crashes between file commits. Staged conflicts, client recovery and file failures are covered by focused fault-injection tests. Scheduler redesign, automatic repair of existing incompatible bindings and Java/control-plane changes are excluded.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: intentional tightening of incompatible replacement admission; no schema or data migration. Existing fixed refusal responses remain recognizable to older clients; current clients additionally display actionable detail. Changing bindings may require cancelling queued/live work under the existing guard.

## Linked Issues

Closes [#13644](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/13644).

---


<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## What this PR does

当替换后的绑定 Host 集合无法提供受影响 Agent 显式固定的程序时，拒绝 Agent Host 替换。在修改持久化状态前报告受影响 Agent ID，保留固定程序；如果兼容的存续 Host 仍满足固定要求，则允许替换。中断的替换即使已经把绑定移到暂存身份，也会重新检查。

注册错误区分确定未注册的密钥与已注册的暂存密钥。确定拒绝时保留旧客户端识别的状态/错误契约，并为当前客户端增加可操作 detail；暂存冲突保留已注册密钥。当前客户端显示 detail，同时保留密钥清理和原身份恢复语义。

## Why it's needed

此前 Host 替换保留程序固定配置，却可能把 Agent 移到不提供该程序的 Host 上。已检查的 pickup 路径会跳过不可用的固定程序，因此这种配置可能让任务停留在队列中而不通知所有者。直接更新绑定已经拒绝不受支持的固定程序；替换需要同等兼容性准入，同时避免静默选择其他程序或破坏注册恢复。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- 将 Agent 固定为 Claude 且仅绑定一个 Host，再尝试替换为只提供 Qwen 的 Host。预期拒绝，显示受影响 ID 和修正建议，注册表、列表均不变且保留固定程序。无效令牌应收到通用拒绝，不含 Agent 详情。
- 修正替换 Host 的程序声明，使用相同且未过期的注册令牌重试。预期替换成功且固定程序不变。另验证存续绑定 Host 提供 Claude 时允许 Qwen-only 替换，而存续 Host 的 v2 不可用探测不能计为支持。
- 验证中断注册和密钥轮换。确定未注册的拒绝必须清理候选密钥或恢复此前已注册密钥；已注册暂存密钥的冲突必须保留该密钥。列表已提交后的重试仍需检查程序兼容性，并复用暂存 Host ID。

已完成的本地验证：`npm run build`、`npm run typecheck`、`npm run bundle`、定向 ESLint 和 Prettier 均通过。在 `packages/core` 执行 `npx vitest run src/agents/workspace-agents/store.test.ts --coverage.enabled=false`，46 项通过。在 `packages/cli` 执行 `npx vitest run src/serve/routes/agent-hosts.test.ts src/serve/agent-host-client.test.ts --coverage.enabled=false`，123 项通过。独立 test-engineer 通过真实 daemon HTTP 路由验证了本地 bundle。已采纳两轮独立设计审计结果，后续实施审查结论为“No findings.”。

### Evidence (Before & After)

修改前：全局 `qwen 0.27.3` HTTP 复现中，将固定 Claude 的 Agent 替换到 Qwen-only Host 返回 `replacementStatus: 201`，在不兼容的新绑定上保留固定程序。当前源码脚本复现了相同的错误准入。

修改后：本地 bundle daemon 记录 `conflictStatus: 401`，附带受影响 ID 和修正 detail，`registryAndRosterBytesUnchanged: true`；声明兼容后记录 `sameTokenAndSecretRetryStatus: 201`。兼容存续 Host 场景记录 `replacementStatus: 201`，保留固定程序和存续绑定。未采集截图或录像；HTTP 观察结果构成前后对比证据。未执行实际无限排队任务或远程程序。

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ tested — 构建、类型检查、bundle、169 项定向测试和本地 daemon HTTP 验证 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment (optional)

macOS；Node.js `v22.18.0`；pnpm `11.24.0`；使用 `node dist/cli.js` 的隔离本地 daemon。全局复现使用 `qwen 0.27.3`。首次构建因已安装 `diff 7.0.0` 不满足所需 `^8.0.3` 而失败，通过 frozen-lockfile 依赖同步及 postinstall 修复；manifest 和 lockfile 未变。一次过早测试在重建期间被 missing-dist 检查拦下；最终测试在前置条件完成、依赖稳定后运行。仍存在无关的构建警告。

## Risk & Scope

- 主要风险或取舍：不兼容替换现在需要操作者修正。准入检查可用声明/探测，不保证 Host 在线，也不保证后续心跳仍报告程序可用。绝不自动解除现有显式固定程序。
- 未验证 / 范围外：Linux/Windows、CI、实际排队任务活性、远程 Claude/Codex 执行、完整混合版本进程及文件提交间隙的真实 daemon 崩溃。暂存冲突、客户端恢复和文件故障由定向故障注入测试覆盖。不包含调度重构、已有不兼容绑定的自动修复和 Java/控制平面变更。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：有意收紧不兼容替换的准入；无需 schema 或数据迁移。旧客户端仍可识别既有固定拒绝响应；当前客户端额外显示可操作 detail。现有保护可能要求先取消排队/运行任务才能修改绑定。

## Linked Issues

关闭 [#13644](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/13644)。

---

prs.title: feat(web-shell): pin the read-turn prompt in split view panes
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Extends the pinned turn prompt feature (first cut in #16095) to Split View panes. This branch builds on top of #16095 (Yash Kakade's first cut) and adds the missing opt-in at the second `TranscriptViewport` call site: `ChatPane` now passes `pinnedPrompt`, so a split pane shows the same pinned prompt overlay as the main transcript. Adds a unit test asserting the pane viewport receives the prop, and updates the design doc (EN + zh-CN): Split View moves from the out-of-scope list to covered scope.

## Why it's needed

#15683 is about losing track of which prompt the visible output belongs to when scrolling a long transcript. That problem exists equally in Split View panes, but the first cut deliberately opted in only at the main transcript call site. The overlay mechanics from #16095 already support panes: the follow range runs while the navigation rail is hidden when `pinnedPrompt` is set, which is exactly the pane situation (panes always pass `hideSessionTimeline`). So extending coverage is a one-line opt-in plus a regression test, with no changes to the overlay itself.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Unit: `cd packages/web-shell && npx vitest run client/components/ChatPane.test.tsx client/components/TranscriptViewport.pinned.test.tsx` — expect all tests green, including the new `pins the prompt of the turn being read in its transcript viewport` test (the mocked pane viewport is asserted to receive `pinnedPrompt`) and all 18 pinned-overlay cases from #16095.
2. Manual (split view): open two sessions in Split View, run a long turn in one pane, scroll the pane transcript above the prompt row — expect the pinned pill with the turn's prompt label at the top of the pane; scroll back to the prompt row — expect the pill to hide. The same behavior already covered by `web-shell.pinned-prompt.spec.ts` for the main transcript now also holds in panes.
3. Typecheck/lint: `tsc -p packages/web-shell/tsconfig.json --noEmit` and eslint on the changed files pass (one pre-existing, unrelated error in `WorkspaceFileBrowser.tsx` against the published `@pierre/trees@1.0.0-beta.6` types exists on `main` as of this branch's base and is out of scope here).

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: in Split View, scrolling a pane transcript above the prompt row shows nothing — no label says which prompt the visible output belongs to (the situation reported in #15683 for the main transcript; the user-facing complaint that started this extension). After: the pane shows the same pinned pill as the main transcript (verified in the local Web Shell with the pane call site opted in). A before/after screenshot pair can be added once the #16095 base is merged and the e2e environment is available.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️    |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️    |

### Environment (optional)

Local `pnpm` checkout of this branch; unit tests and typecheck run directly (no daemon runtime needed for the unit-level assertions).

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: very low. The change is a single opt-in prop at the second existing `TranscriptViewport` call site; the overlay, its constraints (no layout shift, `pointer-events: none`, `aria-hidden`) and the follow-range behavior are unchanged and already covered by #16095's unit and e2e suites for the main transcript.
- Not validated / out of scope: a pane-specific e2e scenario (split view harness) is not added here; the existing e2e spec targets the main transcript. Interaction of the pill with very narrow panes is covered only by the CSS clamp already in #16095.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. No protocol, public API, or settings changes.

Design doc (EN): docs/design/web-shell/web-shell-pinned-turn-prompt.md
Design doc (zh-CN): docs/design/web-shell/web-shell-pinned-turn-prompt.zh-CN.md

## Linked Issues

Extends the coverage of #16095, which implements #15683.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做什么

将固定显示当前轮次提示功能（#16095 的首版）扩展到 Split View 面板。本分支建立在 #16095（Yash Kakade 的首版）之上，补上了第二个 `TranscriptViewport` 调用点的显式开启：`ChatPane` 现在传入 `pinnedPrompt`，因此 Split View 面板会像主转录一样显示固定提示浮层。新增一个单元测试断言面板视口收到了该属性，并更新设计文档（英文 + 中文）：Split View 从「本次不包含」列表移入覆盖范围。

## 为什么需要

#15683 的问题是：在长转录中向上滚动后，丢失「当前可见输出属于哪条提示」的上下文。这个问题在 Split View 面板中同样存在，但首版有意只在主转录调用点开启。#16095 的浮层机制本身已支持面板：当设置 `pinnedPrompt` 时，跟随范围在导航条隐藏时也会运行，而这正是面板的常态（面板始终传入 `hideSessionTimeline`）。因此扩展覆盖只需要一行 opt-in 加一个回归测试，浮层本身没有任何改动。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 单元测试：`cd packages/web-shell && npx vitest run client/components/ChatPane.test.tsx client/components/TranscriptViewport.pinned.test.tsx` —— 预期全部通过，包括新增的 `pins the prompt of the turn being read in its transcript viewport`（断言 mock 的面板视口收到 `pinnedPrompt`）以及 #16095 的 18 个固定浮层用例。
2. 手工验证（Split View）：在 Split View 中打开两个会话，在一个面板里运行一个长轮次，将面板转录滚动到提示行之上 —— 预期面板顶部出现带该轮次提示标签的固定浮层；滚回提示行 —— 预期浮层隐藏。`web-shell.pinned-prompt.spec.ts` 已为主转录覆盖的同一行为现在在面板中同样成立。
3. 类型检查/lint：`tsc -p packages/web-shell/tsconfig.json --noEmit` 与对改动文件的 eslint 通过（`WorkspaceFileBrowser.tsx` 针对已发布的 `@pierre/trees@1.0.0-beta.6` 类型存在一个与本次改动无关的既有错误，在本分支基线的 `main` 上同样存在，不在本 PR 范围内）。

### 证据（前后对比）

之前：在 Split View 中，将面板转录滚动到提示行之上时什么都看不到 —— 没有任何标签说明当前可见输出属于哪条提示（即 #15683 中针对主转录报告的情况，也是本次扩展的起点）。之后：面板显示与主转录相同的固定浮层（已在本地 Web Shell 中验证面板调用点开启后的效果）。待 #16095 基础合并且 e2e 环境可用后，可补充前后对比截图。

### 测试环境

|     操作系统     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️    |

本地 `pnpm` 检出本分支；单元测试与类型检查直接运行（单元级断言不需要 daemon 运行时）。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：很低。改动是第二个既有 `TranscriptViewport` 调用点上的单个 opt-in 属性；浮层本身及其约束（不改变布局、`pointer-events: none`、`aria-hidden`）和跟随范围行为均无变化，且已由 #16095 的单元与 e2e 套件针对主转录覆盖。
- 未验证 / 范围之外：未新增面板专属的 e2e 场景（Split View 测试台）；既有 e2e 规格针对主转录。浮层与极窄面板的交互仅由 #16095 已有的 CSS 限幅覆盖。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。无协议、公共 API 或设置变更。

prs.title: feat(cli): polish terminal layout and streaming interactions
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Keeps the composer at the bottom, centers bounded dialogs over the transcript, and places approval mode beside its cycling shortcut on the input's lower-right border in main and agent views. Virtual scrolling uses smaller paced updates; transcript, preview, and input share consistent drag selection and copying.

Shows completed safe tool/thought activity as muted summaries. Expanding reveals compact command/path rows and retains a clickable collapse header; Ctrl+O reaches original full details. Closing a process clears its expanded children, and independently virtualized members retain their own viewport visibility.

Uses fixed deadlines for streamed state updates and terminal drawing, reuses stable Markdown prefixes and unchanged code-line highlights, and keeps original stream-boundary ordering. Actual controls-height measurement and consistent virtual-message budgets keep advancing text and the final transcript line visible when the footer or auxiliary panels change height.

## Why it's needed

Short conversations left the input above unused space; large settings/session dialogs could overflow. Repeated process details competed with answers, and opening a tool summary could not be reversed. Selection could include popup borders or trigger expansion on release, while approval mode and its shortcut appeared in different places.

Regular small text chunks still appeared in uneven groups. A full new buffering window after each batch introduced avoidable waiting, and stable Markdown/code was processed repeatedly. Long pending paragraphs could hide their advancing tail in short virtual viewports. A stale controls-height budget could also clip the final checkpoint name from `/restore` until scrolling corrected it.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Start an empty session and open `/settings`, `/resume`, model, theme and permission dialogs. The composer should stay at the bottom; dialogs should remain centered and bounded, with the draft restored afterward. Check main and agent inputs: mode and cycling shortcut should share the lower-right border, without a duplicate footer hint. Resize narrow and restore.
2. Run reads, commands and thinking. Completed safe activity should use a muted summary, while live work, failures and approvals remain visible. Click to open compact details, click the retained header to close, and use Ctrl+O for original output. Repeat during and after generation; opening a child then closing its parent should leave the process closed.
3. Scroll slowly, rapidly and in reverse; use PageUp/Home/End and drag the scrollbar. One upward row should remain detached as content arrives. Drag ASCII, Chinese and multiline text in transcript, preview and main/agent input: copied text should match the highlight and exclude borders. Releasing a selection on a summary should not toggle it; an ordinary click should.
4. Stream prose, Chinese, open code and Markdown/list/table content. Updates should advance with less repeated work and retain the exact final suffix. Resize and change rendering context; completed prefixes, syntax colors, gutters and copy hints should remain correct. A long paragraph should keep advancing before completion in a short virtual viewport.
5. Cancel during buffered output and stream reasoning-to-answer, tool-to-answer and inline-image transitions. Preserve the received tail and ordering. Native scrollback and screen-reader modes should retain their existing layout and completion behavior. Do not infer a physical terminal frame rate from a timer setting.
6. Open and close completion, shortcuts and auxiliary panels after history overflows. The final transcript line should remain visible. List checkpoints with `/restore`, then hot-restore and cold-resume one; the name, files and retained conversation should agree without a scroll workaround.

### Evidence (Before & After)

| Installed CLI layout | Bottom-composer layout |
| --- | --- |
| ![Installed CLI](https://github.com/DragonnZhang/qwen-code/blob/b254b90397b50e768275c772449a21a27a936925/docs/design/images/tui-workspace/before-installed.png?raw=true) | ![Bottom composer](https://github.com/DragonnZhang/qwen-code/blob/b254b90397b50e768275c772449a21a27a936925/docs/design/images/tui-workspace/after-startup.png?raw=true) |

These earlier layout captures use isolated fake providers and synthetic data. The installed CLI reports a 0.25.0 banner and is an environment comparison, not a rebuilt PR base. Separate E2E reports record the later pointer, expansion and approval-shortcut checks with their exact artifacts.

With identical synthetic payloads in real PTYs, Chinese visible-marker gap P95 changes from 67ms to 51ms; ASCII remains 51ms. Server-marker-to-visible lag P95 changes from 59/65/93ms to 52/50/88ms for ASCII/Chinese/mixed Markdown. Mixed Markdown visible-gap P95 rises from 117ms to 134ms, so this is not a uniform improvement across all intervals. All five final payloads, including bursts and an 80-line open code block, match exactly.

In a separate controlled 72-update renderer profile, body-write gap P95 changes from 34.73/37.61/38.58ms to 19.77/20.40/19.97ms for prose/labeled code/unlabeled code. Repeated highlighting of unchanged code lines drops from 1296 calls to zero. This profile excludes the application event buffer and native terminal presentation.

Full build, repository typecheck, bundle, focused unit tests, scoped lint/format checks and clean Ink patch application pass. The separate streaming E2E comment records the baseline, candidate and final measurements, exact-content checks, coverage and exclusions.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Real PTYs, Canary/xterm, main and Arena agent views |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not runtime tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Not runtime tested |

### Environment (optional)

Node.js 26.13.1; default Ink renderer; loopback fake providers; isolated settings, sessions, workspace and clipboard shim. Automated pointer checks use standard SGR through Canary/xterm. The user confirmed transcript dragging in Warp; this is not a native Warp/Grok frame-rate comparison.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: shared viewport geometry, pointer ownership, cache invalidation and the existing Ink patch affect terminal behavior. Frozen prefixes are conservative; unfinished text/code still requires work, and very large provider bursts can appear in one update.
- Not validated / out of scope: Windows/Linux runtime interaction and full OpenTUI parity. Arena retains its committed-round display. No output worker or physical VSync acknowledgement is introduced, and no fixed visible 60/120 FPS is promised.
- Known follow-up: continuing one unfinished answer can shift a detached viewport toward older content. The same 16-row shift reproduces in archived pre-increment source with pinned Ink and a test-only JSX runtime shim; this auxiliary replay establishes behavior, not binary timing. The limitation is retained for a focused viewport fix and is not claimed resolved here.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no configuration migration, provider/protocol change or permission-policy change. Input selection copies text; editable replacement ranges are not added. Native scrollback retains its height safety limits.

Designs: [visual hierarchy — English](https://github.com/DragonnZhang/qwen-code/blob/b254b90397b50e768275c772449a21a27a936925/docs/design/tui-visual-hierarchy.md) / [中文](https://github.com/DragonnZhang/qwen-code/blob/b254b90397b50e768275c772449a21a27a936925/docs/design/tui-visual-hierarchy.zh-CN.md); [workspace layout — English](https://github.com/DragonnZhang/qwen-code/blob/53d4cbd95f513d4511fc666fb96258c6d58384d7/docs/design/tui-workspace-layout.md) / [中文](https://github.com/DragonnZhang/qwen-code/blob/53d4cbd95f513d4511fc666fb96258c6d58384d7/docs/design/tui-workspace-layout.zh-CN.md); [scrolling and selection — English](https://github.com/DragonnZhang/qwen-code/blob/43275f059d96d46a2f926ef1519e56bd83848adc/docs/design/tui-pointer-and-composer.md) / [中文](https://github.com/DragonnZhang/qwen-code/blob/43275f059d96d46a2f926ef1519e56bd83848adc/docs/design/tui-pointer-and-composer.zh-CN.md); [streaming and controls — English](https://github.com/DragonnZhang/qwen-code/blob/507e7dfc5410be0460279d503cb4ce3329e55b72/docs/design/tui-streaming-cadence.md) / [中文](https://github.com/DragonnZhang/qwen-code/blob/507e7dfc5410be0460279d503cb4ce3329e55b72/docs/design/tui-streaming-cadence.zh-CN.md); [incremental streaming — English](https://github.com/DragonnZhang/qwen-code/blob/116632670d512725dbeedfb8ae523c55a1bf88c7/docs/design/tui-incremental-streaming.md) / [中文](https://github.com/DragonnZhang/qwen-code/blob/116632670d512725dbeedfb8ae523c55a1bf88c7/docs/design/tui-incremental-streaming.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

N/A — locally reported UI issues.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 此 PR 的改动

将输入框固定在底部，让有尺寸约束的弹窗居中悬浮在聊天区上方，并在主视图和 agent 输入框右下边框，将权限模式与切换快捷键并排显示。虚拟滚动采用较小的按帧位移，聊天区、预览和输入文字采用一致的拖选、复制行为。

将已完成的安全工具和思考过程显示为淡色摘要。展开显示紧凑的命令、路径明细，并保留可点击的收起标题；Ctrl+O 可以查看原始完整详情。收起父过程时清理已展开子项，各个独立虚拟行仍保留自身的视口可见状态。

流式状态更新和终端绘制采用固定截止时间，复用稳定 Markdown 前缀和未变化代码行的高亮，并保留原有流事件边界顺序。跟踪控件的实际高度，并统一虚拟消息的内容预算，使文字持续推进，底部栏和辅助面板改变高度后聊天区最后一行仍可见。

## 为什么需要

短对话的输入框原本悬在空白上方，大型设置和会话弹窗可能溢出。重复过程详情会抢占回答的注意力，打开工具摘要后也无法收起。选择文字可能复制到弹窗边框或在松手时触发展开，权限模式与快捷键也出现在不同位置。

持续到达的小文字分片仍会不均匀地成批出现。每批结束后再等待一个完整缓冲窗口会引入额外等待，稳定 Markdown 和代码也被反复处理。长段落在较矮的虚拟视口里可能藏住正在增长的尾部，控件高度预算过时还会裁掉 `/restore` 的最后一个检查点名，直到滚动触发修正。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 启动空会话，打开 `/settings`、`/resume`、模型、主题和权限弹窗。输入框应保持底部，弹窗应居中且有尺寸约束，关闭后恢复草稿。主输入和 agent 输入的权限模式、切换提示应在右下边框同一组，页脚没有重复提示。缩窄窗口，再恢复。
2. 运行读取、命令和思考。完成的安全过程应采用淡色摘要，运行中活动、失败和审批保持可见。点击打开紧凑明细，再点保留的标题收起，Ctrl+O 查看原始输出。在生成中和完成后分别重复；打开子项再收起父过程，应保持关闭。
3. 缓慢、快速和反向滚动，使用 PageUp/Home/End，并拖动滚动条。向上一行后，新内容到来时保持脱离底部。在聊天、预览、主输入和 agent 输入拖选 ASCII、中文和多行文字，复制应与高亮一致、不含边框。拖选到摘要松手不应切换状态，普通点击可以。
4. 流式输出正文、中文、开放代码和 Markdown、列表、表格。更新应减少重复工作并保留准确最终尾部。缩放窗口并切换渲染上下文，稳定前缀、语法颜色、行号和复制提示仍正确。长段落在较矮虚拟视口里应在完成前持续推进。
5. 在存在缓冲文字时取消，并验证思考转回答、工具转回答和内联图片转换。保留已接收尾部和顺序。原生回滚、读屏模式保留既有布局及完成行为，不将定时器设置视为实际终端帧率。
6. 历史溢出后打开、关闭补全、快捷键和辅助面板，聊天区最后一行应保持可见。用 `/restore` 列出检查点，再执行热恢复和冷启动恢复，显示的名称、文件和保留对话应一致，无需滚动补救。

### 证据（改动前后）

| 已安装 CLI 布局 | 底部输入框布局 |
| --- | --- |
| ![已安装 CLI](https://github.com/DragonnZhang/qwen-code/blob/b254b90397b50e768275c772449a21a27a936925/docs/design/images/tui-workspace/before-installed.png?raw=true) | ![底部输入框](https://github.com/DragonnZhang/qwen-code/blob/b254b90397b50e768275c772449a21a27a936925/docs/design/images/tui-workspace/after-startup.png?raw=true) |

这些较早的布局截图使用隔离模拟模型和合成数据。已安装 CLI 的启动标识为 0.25.0，属于环境对照，不是重建的 PR 基线。独立 E2E 报告记录后续指针、展开及权限快捷键验证和对应准确产物。

相同合成内容在真实 PTY 中回放，中文可见标记间隔 P95 从 67ms 变为 51ms，ASCII 仍为 51ms。ASCII、中文、混合 Markdown 的服务端标记到可见延迟 P95 从 59/65/93ms 变为 52/50/88ms。混合 Markdown 的可见间隔 P95 从 117ms 增至 134ms，因此并非所有间隔都一致改善。五个场景的最终内容均完整一致，包括突发分片和 80 行开放代码块。

独立的 72 次更新受控渲染器测量中，正文、有语言代码、无语言代码的写入间隔 P95 从 34.73/37.61/38.58ms 变为 19.77/20.40/19.97ms。未变化代码行的重复高亮从 1296 次降至零。此测量不包含应用事件缓冲和原生终端实际呈现。

完整构建、仓库类型检查、bundle、定点单测、范围内 lint 和格式检查及 Ink 补丁干净应用均通过。独立流式 E2E 评论记录基线、候选及最终测量、完整文字检查、覆盖和排除项。

### 测试平台

| 操作系统 | 状态 |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 真实 PTY、Canary/xterm、主视图和 Arena agent 视图 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未做运行验证 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未做运行验证 |

### 环境（可选）

Node.js 26.13.1；默认 Ink 渲染器；本机回环模拟模型；隔离的设置、会话、工作区和剪贴板替身。自动化指针检查通过 Canary/xterm 的标准 SGR 完成。用户已确认 Warp 主聊天拖选正常，这不是原生 Warp/Grok 帧率对比。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：共享视口几何、指针归属、缓存失效和现有 Ink 补丁影响终端行为。前缀冻结采取保守边界，未完成文字和代码仍需计算，极大的模型分片也可能一次显示。
- 未验证或不在范围内：Windows/Linux 运行交互和完整 OpenTUI 对齐。Arena 保留按已完成轮次显示。没有新增输出线程或实际屏幕 VSync 反馈，也不承诺固定每秒 60/120 可见帧。
- 已知后续事项：同一条未完成回答继续输出时，脱离底部的视口可能向较早内容移动。改动前的归档源码、固定 Ink 和仅测试使用的 JSX 运行时替身可复现相同的 16 行位移；该辅助回放只用于确认行为，不用于二进制性能对比。此限制留待单独修复视口，不宣称已在这里解决。
- 破坏性变更与迁移说明：无需配置迁移，不改变模型、协议或权限策略。输入选区用于复制，不增加可替换的编辑选区。原生回滚保留高度安全限制。

设计：[视觉层级 — English](https://github.com/DragonnZhang/qwen-code/blob/b254b90397b50e768275c772449a21a27a936925/docs/design/tui-visual-hierarchy.md) / [中文](https://github.com/DragonnZhang/qwen-code/blob/b254b90397b50e768275c772449a21a27a936925/docs/design/tui-visual-hierarchy.zh-CN.md)；[工作区布局 — English](https://github.com/DragonnZhang/qwen-code/blob/53d4cbd95f513d4511fc666fb96258c6d58384d7/docs/design/tui-workspace-layout.md) / [中文](https://github.com/DragonnZhang/qwen-code/blob/53d4cbd95f513d4511fc666fb96258c6d58384d7/docs/design/tui-workspace-layout.zh-CN.md)；[滚动与选择 — English](https://github.com/DragonnZhang/qwen-code/blob/43275f059d96d46a2f926ef1519e56bd83848adc/docs/design/tui-pointer-and-composer.md) / [中文](https://github.com/DragonnZhang/qwen-code/blob/43275f059d96d46a2f926ef1519e56bd83848adc/docs/design/tui-pointer-and-composer.zh-CN.md)；[流式与控件 — English](https://github.com/DragonnZhang/qwen-code/blob/507e7dfc5410be0460279d503cb4ce3329e55b72/docs/design/tui-streaming-cadence.md) / [中文](https://github.com/DragonnZhang/qwen-code/blob/507e7dfc5410be0460279d503cb4ce3329e55b72/docs/design/tui-streaming-cadence.zh-CN.md)；[流式增量渲染 — English](https://github.com/DragonnZhang/qwen-code/blob/116632670d512725dbeedfb8ae523c55a1bf88c7/docs/design/tui-incremental-streaming.md) / [中文](https://github.com/DragonnZhang/qwen-code/blob/116632670d512725dbeedfb8ae523c55a1bf88c7/docs/design/tui-incremental-streaming.zh-CN.md)。

prs.title: feat(cli): add native historical statistics
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds historical Activity and Efficiency to native `/stats` and Settings → Stats. Reports combine the existing user history across projects with the selected live session, replacing that session's saved entry rather than counting it twice. Session metrics remain live.

Activity includes session, duration and token totals, comparisons, heatmap/streak, monthly trends and projects. Efficiency includes cache and tool success rates, weighted latency, tool and model breakdowns, and code impact. Existing range/month navigation and Settings focus rules are retained. Narrow views keep the complete selected tab, current range and key hints above a scrollable, wrapping body. The dedicated TUI gate includes the public history regression.

## Why it's needed

The native historical tabs previously repeated a current-session summary, so users could not inspect persisted usage even though the command and Settings entry were available. Narrow frames also needed to account for wrapping instead of assuming a fixed chrome height.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- With saved sessions across dates, models and projects, open `/stats`. Compare All time, Last 30 days, Last 7 days and Today; month navigation should stay within available data. Switch to Efficiency and verify per-model values and independent latency totals.
- Return to Session, close and reopen, then restart. Confirm that history and live-session usage are not duplicated. In Settings → Stats, statistics keys should follow content focus and Escape should return to the host before closing it.
- Resize through 120×40, 80×18, 40×18, 20×15 and 40×12. The selected tab and frame should remain visible; PageUp/PageDown should navigate the body without hiding labels or values permanently.
- Check empty history and one legacy transcript migration. Existing migration may append a rebuilt summary once; subsequent opens must not repeat it. Seeded valid history should retain its bytes while viewing reports.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: installed-global Ink established the history behavior; the paired native capture reached a live-zero Session but only a current-session Activity placeholder.

prs.title: feat(serve): auto-remove completed sub-sessions after a configurable TTL
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds TTL-based auto-removal of completed sub-sessions in `qwen serve` (daemon mode). A new `serve.subSessionCompletionTtlHours` setting (integer, hours; default `0` — keep completed sub-sessions forever, i.e. today's behavior) controls how long a finished sub-session stays in the workspace session roster before the daemon removes it; auto-removal is opt-in via a positive value.

After a sub-session's turn ends with a clean `end_turn` (an errored or cancelled turn never becomes eligible; the observer stop reasons `timeout`, `incomplete`, `shutdown` are ignored), the sub-session launcher starts a per-session completion clock. A 5-minute sweep (unref'd, serialized, so it never keeps the process alive or re-enters) then removes expired sub-sessions the same way the existing launch-rollback cleanup does: `closeSession` (tolerating entries the bridge reaper already closed) plus `SessionService.removeSession` for the persisted transcript, so an expired sub-session is no longer continuable — consistent with how closed sessions are treated elsewhere (#7420). A revived sub-session (a new prompt after completion) restarts the clock from its latest activity instead of being removed — the sweep confirms it against the persisted transcript's freshness even when the live entry is already gone — and running sub-sessions (an active prompt, running background tasks, or an active work state) are never removed. After a daemon restart, the first sweep rediscovers previously completed sub-sessions from the persisted session catalog (rows with a parent session only — never top-level sessions). Non-integer values and values below a setting's minimum produce a warning and fall back to the built-in default, mirroring the existing `serve.maxConcurrentSubSessions*` handling.

## Why it's needed

Finished sub-sessions (`create_sub_session`, daemon/serve only) currently accumulate in the session roster for the lifetime of the daemon. The bridge reaper closes the live entry of an idle completed sub-session, but the persisted transcript keeps the thread listed in the Web Shell sidebar until the daemon is restarted or the parent session is closed. On long-running daemons this turns into dozens of dead threads under a single parent session with no way to prune them except a restart. This is the request from #14289: auto-removal of completed sub-sessions, terminal-state only, with revival resetting the timer.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Unit level: `cd packages/cli && pnpm vitest run src/serve/create-sub-session.test.ts src/serve/run-qwen-serve.test.ts src/config/settingsSchema.test.ts` — the `sub-session completion TTL` block (21 fake-timer + real-fs lifecycle tests: removal at exactly the TTL moment, terminal state across repeated sweeps, persisted discovery after a restart, revival from persisted-transcript freshness, `0` keeps forever, the live guards — active prompt / background tasks / active work state, reaper arming for unobserved turns, errored and cancelled turns never removed, close-failure recovery, remove-false, transient summary error, in-flight sweep serialization, FIFO-evicted id survival, `stop()` clears the sweeper) plus `subSessionCompletionTtlMsFromSettings` (4 config-reader tests) and the schema pin test (default === runtime default, minimum 0).

Live: run `qwen serve` from this branch with `"serve": { "subSessionCompletionTtlHours": 1 }` in user settings, create a session and let its model spawn one trivial sub-session (`create_sub_session`, `completion: "sent"`). After the sub-session's turn finishes, wait ~65 minutes: the daemon logs `qwen serve: removed completed sub-session <id> from the roster (completion TTL 60min expired)`, the transcript `.jsonl` is gone from `~/.qwen/projects/<slug>/chats/`, and `GET /workspace/<id>/sessions` no longer lists the thread.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before (0.25.1, no such setting exists — the roster only shrinks on daemon restart or parent close):

- Live daemon (0.25.1) with 10 completed sub-sessions under one parent session; transcripts on disk, last activity spread over ~19 hours, all still listed:
  ```
  10-14 17:39  b71c0254-… (410 KB)   10-14 17:51  f728b509-… (727 KB)
  10-14 18:24  c19070d1-… (462 KB)   10-14 20:37  a1fa001e-… (3335 KB)
  10-15 00:55  040484ea-… (1403 KB)  10-15 00:55  27d92160-… (735 KB)
  10-15 00:55  48fa030b-… (1927 KB)  10-15 02:40  56aefda8-… (3133 KB)
  10-15 12:12  bbe2dda6-… (969 KB)   10-15 12:35  ba085532-… (1785 KB)
  ```
  (each file's first record: `type: system, subtype: parent_session` → sub-session of the parent; daemon uptime 14h51m at capture)

After (this branch) — the new `sub-session completion TTL` suite drives the real completion sweeper through a fake-bridge daemon and asserts exactly the behavior this diff adds: a terminal sub-session is removed from the roster and its persisted transcript deleted at precisely the TTL moment; `0` keeps it forever; an active prompt is never removed; a revival restarts the clock from the latest activity; an already-reaped entry is tolerated. This is the same `closeSession` + `SessionService.removeSession` path a live `qwen serve` run exercises (repro steps above).

Machine evidence — the 3 touched test files, per platform:

```

  ✓ settingsSchema.test.ts (63)   ✓ create-sub-session.test.ts (76)   ✓ run-qwen-serve.test.ts (503)
  Tests  642 passed (642)          tsc --noEmit  clean

🍏 macOS   — host, Apple Silicon, node 26.5.0, pnpm 12.10.1 (head d05720432c)

  Tests  637 passed | 5 failed (642)   tsc --noEmit  clean
  the 5 = pre-existing provider-HTTP-installer/voice cluster, outside this diff

🪟 Windows — UTM Win11 ARM, WinOnArm x64, node 22.23.3, pnpm 11.24.0 (head d05720432c)
  ✓ settingsSchema.test.ts (63)   ✓ create-sub-session.test.ts (76)   run-qwen-serve.test.ts (503, 5 failed)
  Tests  637 passed | 5 failed (642)   tsc --noEmit  clean
  the 5 = same pre-existing provider-HTTP-installer/voice cluster (chat/image/voice, "expected 500 to be 200"), outside this diff

All 21 sub-session completion TTL lifecycle tests and all 4 subSessionCompletionTtlMsFromSettings
config-reader tests pass on all three platforms at head d05720432c (after the second main merge,
which touched only run-qwen-serve.ts +2 lines from #13816, no TTL code); every failure above is in
the pre-existing provider-HTTP-installer/voice cluster, none in the touched TTL code.
```

### Environment

On the macOS and Windows hosts, `run-qwen-serve.test.ts` shows the same 5 failures in the provider-HTTP-installer/voice cluster (chat/image/voice, "expected 500 to be 200") — reproduced identically on base `476f624b53` in the same environments (pre-existing, outside this diff; Linux, which lacks the host's provider/voice environment, is fully green).

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: removal is destructive by design (the issue asks for the sub-session to become "not continuable") and is opt-in — the default `0` removes nothing (pre-PR behavior); a positive `serve.subSessionCompletionTtlHours` value starts removing completed sub-sessions after the given time. It reuses the exact cleanup path already run on launch rollback, so the failure modes are identical to the existing one (transcript removal is best-effort and non-fatal; a `SessionNotFoundError` from `closeSession` on an already-reaped entry is expected and tolerated).
- Not validated / out of scope: no live Windows e2e daemon run (unit/typecheck only on the UTM VM); the standalone session path shares the terminal-marking code, but removal for ids without a bridge entry is a harmless no-op (covered by unit tests).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. New opt-in setting; the default `0` is the current behavior, so there is nothing to migrate.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14289

<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做什么

为 `qwen serve`（守护进程模式）中的已完成子会话添加基于 TTL 的自动移除。新增 `serve.subSessionCompletionTtlHours` 设置（整数，单位小时；默认 `0` — 永久保留已完成的子会话，即当前行为），控制一个已完成的子会话在被守护进程移除前在工作区会话名册中保留多久；自动移除为显式开启，设置正值后才生效。

当子会话的一轮以干净的 `end_turn` 结束时（出错或被取消的回合永不纳入；观察者停止原因 `timeout`、`incomplete`、`shutdown` 被忽略），子会话启动器为该会话启动一个完成计时器。一个 5 分钟一次的扫描（unref、串行化，既不会阻止进程退出也不会重入）随后移除过期的子会话，方式与现有的启动回滚清理完全一致：`closeSession`（容忍桥接收割器已关闭的条目）加上 `SessionService.removeSession` 删除持久化转录，使过期的子会话不再可继续——与其他地方对已关闭会话的处理一致（#7420）。被唤醒的子会话（完成后又收到新提示）会从最近一次活动重新开始计时而不是被移除——即使实时条目已消失，扫描也会对照持久化转录的新鲜度加以确认；正在运行的子会话（活动提示、后台任务或 active 工作状态）永不被移除。守护进程重启后，首次扫描会从持久化会话目录重新发现之前已完成的子会话（仅带父会话的行——绝不包含顶级会话）。非整数或低于设置最小值的值会产生警告并回退到内置默认值，与现有 `serve.maxConcurrentSubSessions*` 的处理方式一致。

## 为什么需要

已完成的子会话（`create_sub_session`，仅守护进程/serve 模式）目前会在守护进程存活期间不断堆积在会话名册中。桥接收割器会关闭空闲已完成子会话的实时条目，但持久化的转录会让该线程一直显示在 Web Shell 侧边栏中，直到守护进程重启或父会话关闭。在长期运行的守护进程中，单个父会话下会堆积几十个死线程，除了重启没有任何清理手段。这正是 #14289 的需求：自动移除已完成的子会话，仅限终态，唤醒时重置计时器。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

单元测试：`cd packages/cli && pnpm vitest run src/serve/create-sub-session.test.ts src/serve/run-qwen-serve.test.ts src/config/settingsSchema.test.ts`——`sub-session completion TTL` 测试块（21 个 fake-timer + 真实 fs 生命周期测试：恰好 TTL 时刻移除、移除后的终态（多轮扫描不重复）、重启后从持久化目录重新发现、按转录新鲜度唤醒、`0` 永久保留、live 守卫——活动提示 / 后台任务 / active 工作状态、未观察回合的收割兜底、出错与取消回合永不移除、close 失败恢复、remove 返回 false、瞬时 summary 错误跳过、扫描串行化、FIFO 逐出后 id 仍被移除、`stop()` 清理扫描器）加上 `subSessionCompletionTtlMsFromSettings`（4 个配置读取测试）和模式固定测试（默认值 === 运行时默认值，最小值 0）。

实测：用本分支运行 `qwen serve`，用户配置中设置 `"serve": { "subSessionCompletionTtlHours": 1 }`，创建一个会话并让其模型生成一个平凡子会话（`create_sub_session`，`completion: "sent"`）。子会话一轮结束后等待约 65 分钟：守护进程输出 `qwen serve: removed completed sub-session <id> from the roster (completion TTL 60min expired)`，转录 `.jsonl` 从 `~/.qwen/projects/<slug>/chats/` 消失，`GET /workspace/<id>/sessions` 不再列出该线程。

### 证据（之前与之后）

之前（0.25.1，不存在该设置——名册只在守护进程重启或父会话关闭时缩小）：

- 实时守护进程（0.25.1）中单个父会话下有 10 个已完成子会话；转录在磁盘上，最后活动时间跨越约 19 小时，全部仍在名册中：
  ```
  10-14 17:39  b71c0254-… (410 KB)   10-14 17:51  f728b509-… (727 KB)
  10-14 18:24  c19070d1-… (462 KB)   10-14 20:37  a1fa001e-… (3335 KB)
  ```

之后（本分支）——新增的 `sub-session completion TTL` 测试套件通过一个假桥接守护进程驱动真实的完成清扫器，并精确断言本 diff 新增的行为：终态子会话在 TTL 精确时刻从名册中移除、其持久化转录被删除；`0` 永久保留；活动提示永不被移除；唤醒后计时从最近一次活动重新开始；已被收割的条目被容忍。这与实时 `qwen serve` 运行所执行的同一条 `closeSession` + `SessionService.removeSession` 路径一致（复现步骤见上）。

```
21 个 sub-session completion TTL 生命周期测试和 4 个 subSessionCompletionTtlMsFromSettings 配置读取测试在全部三个平台（head d05720432c，第二次 main 合入之后——该合入仅触及 run-qwen-serve.ts +2 行（来自 #13816），未改 TTL 代码）上均通过；上述所有失败都在既有的 provider-HTTP-installer/voice 测试簇中，没有一个触及本 diff 的 TTL 代码。
```

|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ |

### 环境

macOS 26（Apple Silicon），node 26.5.0（homebrew），`pnpm 12.10.1`；Linux：Docker `node:22-bookworm`（全新容器，`pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`）；Windows：UTM Win11 ARM（WinOnArm x64 模拟），node 22.23.3 + `pnpm 11.24.0`。macOS 和 Windows 主机上 `run-qwen-serve.test.ts` 在 provider-HTTP-installer/voice 测试簇（chat/image/voice，"expected 500 to be 200"）有相同的 5 个失败——在各自同一环境中于基线 `476f624b53` 上完全复现（既有问题，不在本 diff 范围内；Linux 没有宿主的 provider/voice 环境，全绿）。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：移除是破坏性的，这是设计如此（issue 要求子会话变为「不可继续」），且为显式开启——默认 `0` 不移除任何东西（保持 PR 前行为）；设置正值后才开始移除。它复用在启动回滚时已经运行的确切清理路径，因此失效模式与现有一致（转录删除是尽力而为且非致命的；`closeSession` 对已被收割条目返回的 `SessionNotFoundError` 是预期且被容忍的）。

prs.title: test(web-shell): deflake large-file smoke line-count assertions
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Stabilizes the flaky smoke test that opens a large source file and checks the preview stays readable and virtualized. The two assertions that count rendered lines were one-shot reads; they now retry with `expect.poll` on the same bounds, so they wait for the file preview's virtualizer to finish settling instead of sampling it mid-render. No assertion is weakened, skipped, or removed, and no production code changes — this is a test-only timing stabilization.

## Why it's needed

CI Failure Patrol flagged the test as nondeterministic (fail, then pass on a rerun of the same commit) in a heavily contended 28.9-minute shard. The preview renders asynchronously: it emits an initial batch of lines and then prunes to the visible window once the container is measured. A probe sampling the line count during settling captured the transient `0 → 150 → 100`. Under CI contention the layout/measurement that drives the prune is delayed, widening the window in which a one-shot count read can observe a non-settled value. Every other assertion in the test already retries; these two count reads were the only ones racing the async settle. Making them retry removes that race while keeping the exact `> 0` and `< 500` bounds, so a real virtualization regression still fails. (The `Vite proxy ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:4170` line in the CI signature is background noise from an unmocked request reaching the dev-server proxy — it appears on passing runs too and is not the cause.)

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the named test repeatedly and the whole files spec; both should pass every time. From `packages/web-shell` with a Playwright browser available: `npx playwright test --config playwright.config.ts -g "keeps large source files readable" --project=chromium --repeat-each=5`, then `npx playwright test --config playwright.config.ts client/e2e/web-shell.files.spec.ts --project=chromium`. Confirm the diff only changes the two line-count assertions in the large-file smoke test (one-shot reads become retrying polls with identical bounds) and leaves the sibling `long.ts` / `unsupported.lean` tests and all inputs untouched. A genuine virtualization regression (line count permanently ≥ 500 or stuck at 0) still fails the poll after its budget, so the check keeps its teeth.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (test-only change, no UI behavior change). Repeated-run results: named test with the fix `--repeat-each=5` → 5 passed; full `web-shell.files.spec.ts` → 50 passed; restore-confirm `--repeat-each=3` → 3 passed. Mutation probe (reverted to one-shot, `--repeat-each=6`) stayed green locally because the flake is CI-contention-dependent and does not reproduce on a fast idle host; the mechanistic witness is the captured settle transient `0 → 150 → 100` showing the count is not stable at first render.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested |

### Environment (optional)

Linux sandbox; Playwright Chromium launched with locally extracted Debian bookworm shared libraries (`LD_LIBRARY_PATH`) and `PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/tmp/pw-browsers`. Gate commands `npm run build`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint` all passed (build required `COREPACK_HOME=/tmp/corepack` to work around the sandbox denying writes to `~/.cache`).

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the count assertions now tolerate a brief settling transient instead of failing instantly; a real regression still fails once the poll budget elapses, so detection is preserved (just not instantaneous). This is the intended tradeoff for a timing deflake.
- Not validated / out of scope: the flake only manifests under CI contention, so it cannot be reproduced on demand locally; the sibling `long.ts` test uses the same one-shot pattern but was not flagged and is intentionally left unchanged to keep the diff minimal. No production code, build config, or CI machinery is touched.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #17697

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

稳化那个打开大源文件、检查预览保持可读且虚拟化的冒烟测试。原先统计已渲染行数的两条断言是一次性读取；现在改为对相同边界做 `expect.poll` 重试，从而等待文件预览的虚拟化器完成稳定，而不是在渲染过程中采样。没有弱化、跳过或删除任何断言，也不改动任何生产代码 —— 这是仅针对测试的时序稳化。

## 为什么需要

CI Failure Patrol 在一个资源严重争用、耗时 28.9 分钟的分片中判定该测试为非确定性（同一 commit 重跑时先失败后通过）。预览是异步渲染的：先渲染一批初始行，等容器完成测量后再裁剪到可见窗口。一个在稳定过程中采样行数的探针捕捉到瞬态 `0 → 150 → 100`。在 CI 争用下，驱动裁剪的布局/测量被延迟，拉宽了一次性行数读取可能读到未稳定值的时间窗口。测试里其它断言都已重试，只有这两条行数读取在与异步稳定过程竞态。让它们重试即可消除该竞态，同时保留完全相同的 `> 0` 与 `< 500` 边界，因此真正的虚拟化回归仍会失败。（CI 签名里的 `Vite proxy ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:4170` 是未被 mock 的请求到达开发服务器代理所产生的背景噪声 —— 通过的运行里也会出现，并非根因。）

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

重复运行被点名测试以及整个 files 规格，二者应每次都通过。在 `packages/web-shell` 下且具备 Playwright 浏览器时：`npx playwright test --config playwright.config.ts -g "keeps large source files readable" --project=chromium --repeat-each=5`，然后 `npx playwright test --config playwright.config.ts client/e2e/web-shell.files.spec.ts --project=chromium`。确认 diff 仅改动大文件冒烟测试中的两条行数断言（一次性读取变为边界相同的重试 poll），兄弟测试 `long.ts` / `unsupported.lean` 及所有输入保持不变。真正的虚拟化回归（行数长期 ≥ 500 或停留在 0）仍会在 poll 预算耗尽后失败，因此检查依然有效。

### 证据（前后对比）

N/A（仅测试改动，无 UI 行为变化）。重复运行结果：带修复的被点名测试 `--repeat-each=5` → 5 通过；完整 `web-shell.files.spec.ts` → 50 通过；恢复确认 `--repeat-each=3` → 3 通过。变异探针（回退为一次性读取，`--repeat-each=6`）在本地保持绿色，因为该抖动依赖 CI 争用、无法在快速空闲主机上复现；机制层面的证据是捕捉到的稳定瞬态 `0 → 150 → 100`，表明行数在首帧时并不稳定。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ 已测试 |

### 环境（可选）

Linux 沙箱；Playwright Chromium 通过本地解压的 Debian bookworm 共享库（`LD_LIBRARY_PATH`）与 `PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/tmp/pw-browsers` 启动。门禁命令 `npm run build`、`npm run typecheck`、`npm run lint` 均通过（build 需要 `COREPACK_HOME=/tmp/corepack` 以绕过沙箱禁止写入 `~/.cache` 的限制）。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险 / 权衡：行数断言现在容忍短暂的稳定瞬态，而非立即失败；真正的回归仍会在 poll 预算耗尽后失败，因此检测能力得以保留（只是不再瞬时）。这是时序稳化的预期权衡。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：该抖动仅在 CI 争用下出现，无法在本地按需复现；兄弟测试 `long.ts` 使用相同的一次性模式，但未被点名，为保持 diff 最小而有意不改。未触碰任何生产代码、构建配置或 CI 机制。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #17697

</details>

prs.body:
﻿## What this PR does

Clarifies how to select a notebook cell for editing. Use the ID that `read_file` displays. It generates `cell-N` from the zero-based index when the cell has a missing or empty ID.

## Why it’s needed

The previous description presented `cell-N` as a general fallback. For a cell with its own ID, following that guidance produced a failed edit and an unnecessary retry.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Read a notebook whose second cell has ID `code-1`. Replacing `cell-1` should report a missing cell. Replacing `code-1` should update that cell. Repeat with an ID-less notebook. The second cell should be displayed and editable as `cell-1`.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Captured the tool description sent to a loopback model endpoint. The installed 0.28.0 CLI advertised “or cell-N 0-based fallback.” The rebuilt CLI specifies the missing-or-empty ID condition. Both CLIs executed the real read and edit tools on disposable notebooks. The saved notebooks retained their first cell and contained the new source in the second cell after a successful edit.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| --- | --- |
| Windows | Tested |
| macOS | Untested |
| Linux | Untested |

## Risk & Scope

Only the model-facing parameter description changes. The existing lookup and ambiguity checks continue to determine which cell can be edited. The two notebook unit suites passed on Windows (66 passed, one platform-specific FIFO test skipped).

## Linked Issues

Fixes #17725

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

**变更及原因**：编辑笔记本单元格时，使用 `read_file` 显示的 ID。只有单元格缺少 ID 或 ID 为空时，才会根据从零开始的索引生成 `cell-N`。之前的参数说明容易让模型对已有 ID 的单元格尝试无效的索引别名，导致编辑失败并重试。

**验证方法**：读取第二个单元格的 ID 为 `code-1` 的笔记本。使用 `cell-1` 替换应提示找不到单元格，使用 `code-1` 则应成功。对没有 ID 的笔记本重复测试，此时第二个单元格显示为 `cell-1`，可以通过该 ID 编辑。

**前后对比及测试环境**：在 Windows 上使用本地模拟模型端点捕获工具描述，分别运行已安装的 0.28.0 CLI 和本地构建的 CLI。旧版将 `cell-N` 描述为通用回退，新版明确说明了生成条件。两个版本都调用了实际工具读写临时笔记本。成功编辑后，第一个单元格保持原样，第二个单元格包含新的内容。未在 macOS 和 Linux 上验证。

**范围与风险**：仅更新模型看到的参数说明。单元格查找和歧义检查逻辑保持原样。Windows 上的两个笔记本单元测试套件共通过 66 项，跳过一项平台专用的 FIFO 测试。

prs.title: feat(web-shell): assemble the daemon chat controller with attempt-bound settlement
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Lands the daemon adapter's controller assembly for the unified chat surface (slice 2c, adapter core). A dependency-injected factory, `createDaemonChatController`, wraps injected provider facts and actions into the backend-neutral `SessionChatController` and wires the slice-2b intent engine so admission stays separate from establishment. Its new logic is the correlation the engine left open: an incoming daemon event is bound to the attempt it belongs to before it can settle anything. Settlement elevates only the attempt bound to the event's prompt id (submit/cancel) or request id (approval/question), so a late event for a finished attempt cannot establish a retry that shares the same visible target. A turn's terminal event closes both the submit that started it and any cancel that targeted it; evidence that arrives while the POST is in flight is retained by backend identity and applied once the attempt can be named; and orphan witnesses for identities this controller never dispatched are pruned so they neither accumulate nor certify a future attempt. Transcript messages, status facts, capability flags, and the capability-gated sub-controllers pass through from the provider — the adapter does not re-project them.

This is a foundation slice: the controller is not yet rendered. The binding hook that constructs its dependencies from `DaemonSessionProvider` contexts, and the `ChatSurface` component that consumes it (the main-column switch with the visual before/after gate), are the next increments. No existing behavior changes here.

## Why it's needed

The unified chat surface contract's central invariant is that admission is not establishment, and the slice-2b engine proved it at the lifecycle level but could not authenticate an external witness on its own — an internally minted operation id does not bind a daemon event to the attempt it establishes. This slice discharges that correlation requirement at the adapter boundary: the daemon's `onAdmitted` prompt id and its terminal/decision events are bound to the dispatched attempt, and uncorrelatable or late evidence stays unverified rather than declaring a new attempt complete. Landing it with the negative tests before the surface switch keeps the risky extraction building on an already-proven invariant.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the controller's tests (and the engine's, unchanged) from `packages/web-shell`:

```
cd packages/web-shell
npx vitest run client/daemon/chat-controller.test.ts client/daemon/chat-intents.test.ts
```

Observed locally: `Test Files 2 passed`, `Tests 55 passed` (16 controller + 39 engine). The controller cases assert, with a fake injected provider: a resolved submit transport stays `unsettled` until the turn settles (and `failed` terminalizes); a rejected submit is not tracked; a late terminal event for a finished attempt cannot establish a retry on the same visible target while the retry's own event does; out-of-order events keep their effect on the attempt they name; evidence delivered during the POST is applied once admission resolves (and the intent returns the post-bind outcome); an orphan terminal event for a never-dispatched prompt cannot certify a later attempt; a duplicate terminal event does not re-settle an established attempt; a resolved cancel stays `cancelling` until the turn settles `cancelled`; a decision applied to a live request establishes while a superseded one never does (terminal `failed`, outcome never certified); an accepted decision without evidence stays `unsettled`; a question answer establishes; pass-through facts are exposed and read live through getter-backed deps; and an aborted signal releases the evidence subscriptions.

The discriminating power is reproducible by mutation: in `client/daemon/chat-controller.ts`, remove the orphan-witness prune in `pruneCorrelation` and the orphan case reds while the in-flight case stays green; bind settlement by visible session/turn target instead of the backend identity and the late-event/out-of-order cases red; drop the terminal-witness retention and the in-flight case reds; return the dispatch snapshot instead of the post-bind result and the in-flight outcome assertion reds. Restore to return to green.

Type gates (the stricter CI build gate is `tsconfig.lib.json`):

```
cd packages/web-shell
npx tsc -p tsconfig.lib.json --noEmit   # exit 0
npx tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit       # exit 0 (includes the test file)
```

ESLint and Prettier are clean on the touched files. Note: a stale local `@qwen-code/sdk` dist after a baseline change can produce unrelated errors in files this PR does not touch; `corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` (which builds the SDK) resolves them before judging the gate.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — additive module and tests; no UI or behavior change. The controller is consumed by the upcoming surface switch.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Local unit tests and type checks only (vitest + tsc). The controller is dependency-injected and imports no daemon runtime, so no daemon is needed to test it.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the controller is a foundation not yet consumed by production code; it is rendered by the upcoming surface switch. It is backend-neutral in form, lives under `daemon/` outside `chat-core`, and imports only the contract and the engine, so it introduces no daemon value-import edge into the kernel and no cycle.
- Not validated / out of scope: the binding hook (provider contexts -> deps), the `ChatSurface` component and main-column switch with the visual gate, and exposing `acknowledge`/`abandon` on the contract so the surface can release consumed terminal rows and give a thrown transport an exit. A cancel dispatched with no admitted prompt has nothing to bind; the surface enables cancel only while a turn is in flight. Managed adapter stays in slice 3.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. No routes, storage keys, session namespaces, or UI behavior change.

Design: [daemon chat controller (EN)](../blob/feat/unified-chat-surface-slice2c-daemon-controller/docs/design/2026-11-19-daemon-chat-controller.md) · [简体中文](../blob/feat/unified-chat-surface-slice2c-daemon-controller/docs/design/2026-11-19-daemon-chat-controller.zh-CN.md). Part of the [unified chat surface](../blob/main/docs/design/2026-11-16-unified-chat-surface.md) migration; builds on the merged contract (#17520), composer decoupling (#17661), status-stack extraction (#17684), and daemon intent engine (#17709).

## Linked Issues

Part of slice 2 of the unified chat surface design (#17460). Follows the merged slice-2b daemon intent engine #17709.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

为统一聊天界面落地 daemon 适配器的控制器组装（slice 2c，适配器核心）。一个依赖注入的工厂 `createDaemonChatController`，把注入的 provider 事实与动作包装成后端中立的 `SessionChatController`，并接入 slice-2b 意图引擎，使 admission 与 establishment 保持分离。它的新逻辑是引擎留下的**关联**：到来的 daemon 事件在能结算任何东西之前，先被绑定到它所属的那次尝试。结算只提升绑定到事件 prompt id（submit/cancel）或 request id（approval/question）的尝试，故已结束尝试的迟到事件无法建立共享同一可见 target 的重试。一个 turn 的终态事件同时关闭启动它的 submit 与指向它的 cancel；POST 在飞时到达的证据按后端身份保留、并在尝试能被点名时应用；本控制器从未派发过的身份的孤儿见证被裁剪，故既不累积、也不会认证未来的尝试。transcript 消息、状态事实、能力旗标、能力门控的子控制器都从 provider 透传——适配器不重新投影。

这是基础切片：控制器尚未被渲染。从 `DaemonSessionProvider` 各 context 构造其依赖的绑定 hook、以及消费它的 `ChatSurface` 组件（带视觉前后对比门的主列切换），是接下来的增量。此处不改任何现有行为。

## 为什么需要

统一聊天界面契约的核心不变量是「admission 不等于 establishment」。slice-2b 引擎在生命周期层面证明了它，但无法独自认证外部见证——内部铸造的操作 id 并不能把 daemon 事件绑定到它所建立的尝试。本切片在适配器边界兑现该关联要求：daemon 的 `onAdmitted` prompt id 及其终态/决定事件被绑定到被派发的尝试，无法关联或迟到的证据保持未验证，而不是宣告新尝试已完成。在表面切换前随负向测试落地，让风险更高的抽取建立在已被证明的不变量之上。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

从 `packages/web-shell` 运行控制器测试（及未改动的引擎测试）：

```
cd packages/web-shell
npx vitest run client/daemon/chat-controller.test.ts client/daemon/chat-intents.test.ts
```

本地实测：`Test Files 2 passed`、`Tests 55 passed`（16 控制器 + 39 引擎）。控制器用例用 fake 注入 provider 断言：已 resolve 的 submit transport 在 turn 结算前保持 `unsettled`（`failed` 终态化）；rejected submit 不跟踪；已结束尝试的迟到终态事件无法建立同可见 target 的重试、而重试自己的事件可以；乱序事件各落在它点名的尝试；POST 期间送达的证据在 admission 解析后应用（意图返回绑定后的 outcome）；从未派发过的 prompt 的孤儿终态事件不能认证之后的尝试；重复终态事件不再结算已建立尝试；已 resolve 的 cancel 在 turn 结算 `cancelled` 前保持 `cancelling`；作用于存活请求的决定建立、被取代者绝不（终态 `failed`、outcome 绝不认证）；无证据的已准入决定保持 `unsettled`；question 应答建立；透传事实被暴露且经 getter 支撑的 deps 活读；abort 的 signal 释放证据订阅。

判别力可通过变异复现：在 `client/daemon/chat-controller.ts` 中去掉 `pruneCorrelation` 的孤儿见证裁剪，孤儿用例转红、在飞用例仍绿；把结算改按可见 session/turn target 而非后端身份绑定，迟到事件/乱序用例转红；去掉终态见证保留，在飞用例转红；返回 dispatch 快照而非绑定后结果，在飞 outcome 断言转红。还原即回绿。

类型门（更严格的 CI 构建门是 `tsconfig.lib.json`）：

```
cd packages/web-shell
npx tsc -p tsconfig.lib.json --noEmit   # exit 0
npx tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit       # exit 0（含测试文件）
```

ESLint 与 Prettier 在改动文件上干净。注意：换基线后本地陈旧的 `@qwen-code/sdk` dist 会在本 PR 未改动的文件上报无关错误；判定该门前先 `corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`（会构建 SDK）。

### 证据（前后对比）

N/A——新增模块与测试；无 UI 或行为变更。控制器由接下来的表面切换消费。

### 测试平台

🍏 macOS ✅（本地）；🪟 Windows ⚠️；🐧 Linux ⚠️（交由 CI）。

### 环境

仅本地单元测试与类型检查（vitest + tsc）。控制器依赖注入、不导入 daemon 运行时，测试无需 daemon。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/取舍：控制器是尚未被生产代码消费的基础，将由接下来的表面切换渲染。其形式后端中立、位于 `daemon/` 在 `chat-core` 之外、仅导入契约与引擎，故不向内核引入 daemon 值导入边、也无循环。
- 未验证/超出范围：绑定 hook（provider context -> deps）、`ChatSurface` 组件与带视觉门的主列切换、以及在契约上暴露 `acknowledge`/`abandon` 使表面能释放已消费终态行并给抛错 transport 出路。无已准入 prompt 时派发的 cancel 无可绑定；表面仅在 turn 在飞时启用 cancel。managed 适配器留在 slice 3。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：无。不改路由、存储键、会话命名空间或 UI 行为。

设计文档：[daemon chat controller（英文）](../blob/feat/unified-chat-surface-slice2c-daemon-controller/docs/design/2026-11-19-daemon-chat-controller.md) · [简体中文](../blob/feat/unified-chat-surface-slice2c-daemon-controller/docs/design/2026-11-19-daemon-chat-controller.zh-CN.md)。属于[统一聊天界面](../blob/main/docs/design/2026-11-16-unified-chat-surface.md)迁移；建立在已合入的契约（#17520）、composer 解耦（#17661）、状态栈抽取（#17684）与 daemon 意图引擎（#17709）之上。

## 关联 Issue

属于统一聊天界面设计（#17460）slice 2 的一部分。承接已合入的 slice-2b daemon 意图引擎 #17709。

</details>

prs.title: feat(core): add local notes compaction with a strategy selector
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds an opt-in local notes compaction strategy. Users can select **Summary** or **Notes and History** under **Chat Compression Strategy** in `/settings`, or set `model.chatCompression.strategy` to `summary` or `notes` in `settings.json`. Summary remains the default; changing the selection requires restarting Qwen Code.

Eligible main sessions gain `session_notes`, `session_history`, `get_context_remaining`, and `new_context`. The model can persist a bounded working checkpoint, start a smaller context from that checkpoint and the latest consumed user request, and recover omitted evidence from the active branch of its local session log. Successful notes rollovers make no summarization request. Notes revisions live in the existing JSONL transcript, with a generated Markdown projection for inspection; checkpoint persistence must succeed before active history changes. Resume, fork, rewind, archive, and deletion handle the matching notes state.

Missing, stale, or unusable notes fall back to summary for automatic and ordinary manual compression. An explicit `new_context` requires a fresh revision and reports an error if it cannot commit. `/compress <instructions>` continues to summarize, and `/compress-fast` keeps its existing behavior. The notes tool bundle respects recording availability and tool policy and is excluded from subagents, teammates, and nested code-mode calls. Ink and OpenTUI display a notes-specific transition notice.

## Why it's needed

Repeated full-history summaries can lose constraints, decisions, and tool evidence that a long task needs later. A local working checkpoint plus bounded history retrieval gives the model a way to carry forward its current state and recover details on demand. Storage and retrieval use the existing session log and require no additional memory backend. Selected notes and retrieved history still go to the configured model provider as normal inference input. Real-model quality, total token cost, and latency remain to be measured before considering a default change.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Start the local build with no strategy configured and confirm summary behavior. Open `/settings`, search for `compression`, switch to **Notes and History**, and confirm the saved value is `model.chatCompression.strategy: "notes"` and the restart notice appears. Restart and check that the four notes tools are available. Repeat with `summary`, including activation through `settings.json`.
2. In an isolated recorded session, have the model write notes and request a new context in separate tool-only responses using the returned revision. Repeat three times. Each new context should retain the checkpoint and current user constraints, with no summarizer request. Deliberately omit an earlier identifier from the notes, then recover it through history search/read. Resume the session and check that its latest notes revision and old history reference still work.
3. Check that missing/stale revisions, oversized notes, and notes/reset calls mixed with ordinary text or tools cannot install a new context. Disabling recording or denying a required notes tool should disable the complete bundle. After switching to a smaller model window, existing bounded notes should remain readable, while an oversized checkpoint must be shortened before it can authorize a reset.
4. Compare compression commands: `/compress` with fresh notes should use notes; missing/stale notes should fall back to summary; `/compress <instructions>` should forward those instructions to the summarizer even with fresh notes; `/compress-fast` should retain its current tool-output clearing behavior. Check that the next model request uses the committed context and that notes transitions show the notes-specific notice.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Actual tmux captures of `/settings`, with the search set to `compression`:

**Before — global `qwen` `0.23.3-nightly.20260913.faa395885e`:**

```text
No settings match your search.
```

**After — local bundle `0.24.1`:**

```text
Chat Compression Strategy                                                   Notes and History*
Choose summary compression or local notes with history recovery. Restart Qwen Code to apply.
To see changes, Qwen Code must be restarted. Press r to exit and apply changes now.
```

The fresh-notes `/compress` case displayed `Started a new context from local notes` in the actual TUI. The complete deterministic headless/tmux run passed settings persistence, tool availability, history recovery/resume, six rejection cases, and all six manual-compression cases. After the final fixes, the rebuilt handoff rerun again committed **three distinct notes windows in 15 main requests with zero summarizer requests**; resume took three requests and restored the same notes revision and historical reference.

`npm run build`, `npm run typecheck`, and `npm run bundle` passed. Relevant core, ACP, settings/schema/i18n, and Ink/OpenTUI regression tests passed. The final focused rerun passed 23 core tests and 54 event-adapter tests; the commit hook also passed formatting and ESLint. A separate comment contains the E2E matrix and coverage limits.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested locally |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ Not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

macOS arm64, Node.js `v26.8.2`; local bundled CLI `0.24.1`; isolated temporary settings and runtime directories; deterministic localhost OpenAI-compatible provider; headless CLI and real tmux interaction. The user's normal settings and sessions were not modified by the tests.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: This changes core recording, compaction, and replay paths. Correctness depends on fresh notes, successful checkpoint persistence, and branch-correct recovery; note completeness still depends on the model. The Markdown file is a generated view, so editing it directly does not update canonical notes.
- Not validated / out of scope: Real-model task quality, token/cost/latency comparisons, full ACP/Web Shell E2E, other provider wire protocols, process-crash/disk/lease fault injection, and Windows/Linux execution. The deterministic E2E suite does not cover automatic/hard-overflow triggers, nested code mode, or fork/rewind/archive lifecycle operations; focused regression tests cover relevant runtime paths, without claiming end-to-end coverage. Cross-session memory, multi-file notes, and a notes editor are out of scope.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: No settings migration is required. `summary` remains the default, existing transcripts remain supported, and enabling or disabling `notes` requires a restart. Ordinary compression can use summary fallback; an explicit `new_context` never silently summarizes.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/158a0511ddcdd465e14083c56d0f9c7cc8ac629a/docs/design/2026-09-19-local-notes-compaction.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/158a0511ddcdd465e14083c56d0f9c7cc8ac629a/docs/design/2026-09-19-local-notes-compaction.zh-CN.md). Both versions are complete and synchronized, including decisions, constraints, acceptance criteria, and follow-up validation.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #12257

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的内容

增加可选的本地 notes 压缩策略。用户可以在 `/settings` 的 **上下文压缩方式** 中选择 **摘要** 或 **笔记与历史**，也可以在 `settings.json` 中把 `model.chatCompression.strategy` 设为 `summary` 或 `notes`。默认仍为摘要；修改选项后需要重启 Qwen Code。

符合条件的主会话获得 `session_notes`、`session_history`、`get_context_remaining` 和 `new_context` 四个工具。模型可以保存有大小限制的工作笔记，从笔记和最近已消费的用户请求启动更小的上下文，再从本地 session log 的有效分支找回遗漏证据。成功的 notes 换窗口不发起摘要请求。笔记版本保存在现有 JSONL transcript 中，并生成方便查看的 Markdown 文件；只有恢复 checkpoint 持久化成功后才替换当前历史。恢复、分叉、回退、归档和删除操作会处理对应的笔记状态。

自动压缩和普通手动压缩在笔记缺失、过期或不可用时回退到摘要。显式调用 `new_context` 必须提供新鲜的笔记版本，无法提交时返回错误。`/compress <instructions>` 继续生成摘要，`/compress-fast` 保持现有行为。笔记工具组遵循录制可用性及工具策略，并对 subagent、teammate 和嵌套 code-mode 调用关闭。Ink 和 OpenTUI 会显示专门的 notes 换窗口提示。

## 为什么需要

反复生成全历史摘要可能丢失长任务后续需要的约束、决策和工具证据。本地工作笔记加上有界历史检索，使模型能够保留当前工作状态并按需找回细节。存储和检索复用现有 session log，不需要新增 memory 后端。选中的笔记和检索出的历史仍会作为正常推理输入发送给配置的模型 provider。在考虑修改默认策略前，仍需评估真实模型的任务质量、总 token 成本和延迟。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 使用本地构建启动，不配置策略时确认仍使用摘要。打开 `/settings`，搜索 `compression`，切换到 **Notes and History**，确认保存的值为 `model.chatCompression.strategy: "notes"` 并显示重启提示。重启后检查四个笔记工具可用。再切回 `summary`，并验证通过 `settings.json` 启用的行为一致。
2. 在隔离且开启录制的会话中，让模型先写笔记，再用返回的 revision 请求新上下文；两次调用分别放在独立且只含该工具的回复中。重复三次。每个新上下文都应保留 checkpoint 和当前用户约束，且不发起摘要请求。故意不把某个早期标识符写入笔记，再通过历史搜索和读取找回。恢复会话后，检查最新笔记版本和旧历史引用仍可用。
3. 检查缺失或过期的 revision、超限笔记，以及混入普通文本或其他工具的笔记/换窗口调用，都不能安装新上下文。关闭录制或拒绝任一必需工具后，整个笔记工具组应被关闭。切换到窗口更小的模型后，已有且满足固定大小上限的笔记仍应可读，但超过当前模型预算的 checkpoint 必须缩短后才能用于换窗口。
4. 对比压缩命令：笔记新鲜时 `/compress` 应使用笔记；笔记缺失或过期时应回退到摘要；即使有新鲜笔记，`/compress <instructions>` 也应把指定要求转交摘要模型；`/compress-fast` 应保留现有清理工具输出的行为。检查下一次模型请求使用已提交的上下文，且 notes 换窗口显示对应提示。

### 证据（前后对比）

以下为真实 tmux 捕获的 `/settings` 画面节选，搜索词为 `compression`：

**修改前：全局 `qwen` `0.23.3-nightly.20260913.faa395885e`：**

```text
No settings match your search.
```

**修改后：本地 bundle `0.24.1`：**

```text
Chat Compression Strategy                                                   Notes and History*
Choose summary compression or local notes with history recovery. Restart Qwen Code to apply.
To see changes, Qwen Code must be restarted. Press r to exit and apply changes now.
```

使用新鲜笔记执行 `/compress` 时，真实 TUI 显示 `Started a new context from local notes`。完整的确定性 headless/tmux 测试通过了设置持久化、工具可用性、历史找回与会话恢复、六项拒绝场景以及全部六项手动压缩场景。最终修复后重新构建并复测交接，再次在 **15 次主模型请求中提交了三个不同的 notes 窗口，摘要请求为零**；恢复过程使用三次请求，恢复了相同的笔记版本和历史引用。

`npm run build`、`npm run typecheck` 和 `npm run bundle` 均通过。相关 core、ACP、设置/schema/国际化、Ink/OpenTUI 回归测试均通过。最后的针对性复测通过了 23 个 core 测试和 54 个 event-adapter 测试；提交钩子的格式和 ESLint 检查也通过。另附评论列出 E2E 场景矩阵和覆盖范围。

### 测试平台

| 平台 | 状态 |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |

### 环境（可选）

macOS arm64、Node.js `v26.8.2`、本地 CLI bundle `0.24.1`；使用隔离的临时设置和 runtime 目录、确定性的 localhost OpenAI 兼容模型服务、headless CLI 和真实 tmux 交互。测试未修改用户日常使用的设置和会话。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：涉及 core 的录制、压缩和回放路径。正确性依赖笔记新鲜度、checkpoint 成功持久化以及有效分支恢复；笔记内容是否完整仍依赖模型。Markdown 文件只是生成视图，直接编辑不会更新权威笔记。
- 未验证或不在范围内：真实模型任务质量、token/成本/延迟对比、完整 ACP/Web Shell E2E、其他 provider 的通信协议、进程崩溃/磁盘/写入租约故障注入，以及 Windows/Linux 运行。确定性 E2E 未覆盖自动/硬溢出触发、嵌套 code mode 或分叉/回退/归档生命周期操作；针对性回归测试覆盖了相关运行时路径，但不代表完成了这些场景的端到端验证。跨会话记忆、多文件笔记和笔记编辑器不在本次范围内。
- 破坏性变更或迁移说明：无需迁移设置。默认仍为 `summary`，继续支持已有 transcript；开启或关闭 `notes` 需要重启。普通压缩可以回退到摘要；显式 `new_context` 绝不会悄悄改用摘要。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/158a0511ddcdd465e14083c56d0f9c7cc8ac629a/docs/design/2026-09-19-local-notes-compaction.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/158a0511ddcdd465e14083c56d0f9c7cc8ac629a/docs/design/2026-09-19-local-notes-compaction.zh-CN.md)。两个版本完整同步，包括决策、约束、验收标准和后续验证。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #12257

</details>
