prs.title: test(web-shell): cover host-supplied Plan in simple menus
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds desktop and mobile tests for the simple composer's add menu when the host supplies a working Plan toggle. Each test opens the menu, checks that it actually appeared, and verifies that Plan stays hidden.

## Why it's needed

The existing absence check also passes when the host never supplies Plan. Desktop and mobile render the toggle separately, so either could expose it in simple mode.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Open each simple menu with a Plan toggle supplied by the host. The desktop file action and the mobile drawer confirm that their respective menus opened. Neither menu should offer Plan.

### Evidence (Before & After)

All 66 tests in the menu suite passed. In a temporary copy I removed the simple-mode condition from each Plan render path. The two new tests then failed on the unexpected desktop menu item and mobile button respectively.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| --- | --- |
| macOS | Untested |
| Windows | Passed |
| Linux | Untested |

## Risk & Scope

The change adds two component tests using the existing menu fixtures. Browser layout and the other composer follow-ups remain outside this PR.

## Linked Issues

Addresses R1-7 in #15691.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

### 改动与原因

新增桌面端和移动端测试，覆盖宿主向简洁输入框提供可用的 Plan 开关时的添加菜单。两个测试都先打开菜单并确认其已经显示，再检查 Plan 仍然隐藏。已有的缺失检查在宿主根本没有提供 Plan 时也会通过。两个界面分别渲染这个开关，任何一处都可能意外在简洁模式下显示它。

### 验证方法与结果

让宿主提供 Plan 开关，分别打开两个简洁菜单。桌面的文件操作和移动端的抽屉分别证明菜单已打开，两者均应隐藏 Plan。Windows 下菜单测试全部通过，共 66 项。在临时副本中移除两处 Plan 渲染条件里的简洁模式判断后，两个新测试分别检测到多出的桌面菜单项和移动端按钮并失败。未在 macOS 或 Linux 上运行。

### 风险与范围

此次改动使用已有菜单夹具添加两个组件测试。浏览器布局和其他输入框后续事项不在此次改动范围内。对应 #15691 中的 R1-7。

</details>

prs.body:
## What this PR does

Updates the `/tools` help for on-demand tools in direct mode. It explains that the model uses `tool_search` to inspect a schema and `tool_call` to invoke the tool. It also tells users where to look if either tool is missing. The developer-facing descriptions of the eager allowlist and Skill permission grants now use the same distinction.

## Why it's needed

A user can see an on-demand tool listed even when the session lacks one half of the bridge. The old help said that enabling search would load it. A deny rule for either bridge tool makes that advice incomplete. The settings migration guide already documents the two-tool requirement in #16750.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

In an English Ink session with an empty eager allowlist, open `/tools` and read the footnote below the on-demand tools. Repeat with a deny rule for either bridge tool. The help should describe how to inspect and run a deferred tool, point to the relevant settings, and retain the guidance for sending schemas upfront.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before, the installed CLI said “tool_search can load them when enabled.” After, the footnote names both tools and points users to `tools.toolSearch.enabled`, `tools.disabled`, and `permissions.deny`. See the separate terminal verification report for the observed sessions.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| --- | --- |
| Windows | Full build and typecheck passed, 83 targeted tests passed, and all three Ink checks passed. |
| macOS | Not run |
| Linux | Not run for this change |

## Risk & Scope

The terminal help is the only change visible at runtime. The core edits document existing registration and invocation behavior. This PR changes neither which tools a session registers nor how it applies permission rules.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #10339.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

### 改动与动机

更新直接模式下 `/tools` 对按需工具的提示。模型先用 `tool_search` 查看工具的参数结构，再用 `tool_call` 调用它。缺少其中任一工具时，提示会指出应检查的设置。关于预加载白名单和技能授权的开发者说明也与这一行为保持一致。

即使缺少其中一个桥接工具，用户仍可能在列表中看到按需工具。旧提示只提到启用搜索，无法解释其中一个工具被拒绝的情况。设置迁移指南已在 #16750 中说明需要两个工具。

### 评审验证

在英文 Ink 会话中将预加载白名单设为空，打开 `/tools` 并阅读按需工具下方的提示。分别拒绝其中一个桥接工具后重复检查。提示应说明查看参数结构和调用工具各需哪一个工具，指出相关设置，并保留如何预先提供参数结构的说明。

已安装版本的提示声称启用 `tool_search` 即可加载工具。更新后会列出两个工具，并指向 `tools.toolSearch.enabled`、`tools.disabled` 和 `permissions.deny`。实际终端会话的结果见单独的验证报告。

Windows 验证：完整构建、类型检查、83 个定向用例和三组 Ink 终端检查均通过。此改动未在 macOS 或 Linux 上运行。

### 范围

运行时可见的改动仅为终端提示。核心代码中的改动仅更新注释，保留现有工具注册和权限行为。修复 #10339。

</details>

prs.title: perf(web-shell): reduce input lag during history replay
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Reduce transcript overscan from 20 to 15 rows while keeping enhanced Markdown tables. When following the latest message, use cached or estimated row sizes for the initial mount and let ResizeObserver apply actual sizes after layout. Restore a table's scroll position when its fullscreen transition has saved one.

## Why it's needed

A full history reload can mount many rows and enhanced tables together. Synchronous row-height reads and default table scroll writes can repeatedly trigger layout and delay typing after the composer is editable. A recorded session reproduced up to 1,706 ms from key dispatch to the editor DOM on the original build.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Reload a long conversation that contains enhanced tables and fenced code. Once the composer is focused and editable, type during the replay. In the local replay harness, use the longest frame in that window and check that all typed characters reach the editor within 700 ms.
2. Scroll quickly in both directions, return to the latest reply, and check that the draft remains. Scroll upward to load older pages and check that the reading row stays in view.
3. Search for a stored message outside the loaded page. Select the result and verify that the correct message comes into view and the draft remains.
4. Scroll an enhanced table on both axes, enter fullscreen, and exit. Verify that the scroll position and focus return.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The same recorded JSONL supplied 185 updates for the recent-page baseline and 1,220 for full replay. The original production build took up to 43 ms for the recent page and 1,706 ms for full replay. With overscan 15 and both layout changes, the earlier three full replays peaked at 409 ms. The PR commit replayed the same recent page once and the full history three times. The slowest key reached the DOM in 20 ms for the recent page and 371 ms for full replay. All 30 full-replay keys reached the DOM after focus returned. Fast scrolling, history pagination and search passed on the same build.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| --- | --- |
| macOS | Chromium 149 production replay and browser acceptance |
| Windows | — |
| Linux | — |

### Environment

Local production Web Shell build with a loopback daemon mock. The replay measures browser-trusted keystrokes while the composer is focused and editable.

## Risk & Scope

- A smaller overscan reduces the number of rows held beyond the viewport. The fast-scroll check samples viewport coverage across varied row heights.
- Actual row measurements still back the reading, older-page and navigation paths. The changes use the existing transcript and configuration formats.
- [English design](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/3c13c49bb20dcb1b2e90d3ef8b3df90720c4bb82/docs/design/2026-11-19-web-shell-replay-layout.md) · [简体中文设计](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/3c13c49bb20dcb1b2e90d3ef8b3df90720c4bb82/docs/design/2026-11-19-web-shell-replay-layout.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

—

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 改动内容

将消息列表的预渲染范围从 20 行调到 15 行，保留增强 Markdown 表格。跟随最新消息时，首次挂载使用已缓存或估算的行高，由 ResizeObserver 在布局后刷新真实行高。表格全屏切换保存过滚动位置时，重新挂载会恢复该位置。

## 改动原因

全量重载会同时挂载许多消息行和增强表格。同步读行高和首次写默认滚动位置可能反复触发布局，输入框恢复可编辑后仍会出现等待。原始构建回放一份录制会话时，按键发出到写入输入框 DOM 最长用了 1,706 ms。

## 审阅者验收计划

### 验证方式

1. 重载包含增强表格和代码块的长会话。输入框有焦点且可编辑后，在回放期间输入。在本地回放工具中确认按键命中这段时间里的最长帧，并在 700 ms 内写入输入框。
2. 快速上下滚动，回到最新一条回复，确认草稿保留。向上滚动加载旧页，确认此前阅读的消息仍在视口内。
3. 搜索已加载窗口以外的历史消息。选择结果，确认页面定位到正确消息并保留草稿。
4. 横向和纵向滚动增强表格，进入全屏后退出，确认恢复滚动位置和焦点。

### 前后对比

同一份录制 JSONL 的最近一页包含 185 条更新，全量包含 1,220 条更新。原始生产构建中，最近一页最慢 43 ms 写入输入框，全量最慢 1,706 ms。使用 overscan 15 和两项布局优化后，前一轮的三次全量回放最慢为 409 ms。PR 提交在同一份最近页上跑了一轮，在全量历史上跑了三轮。最近页最慢 20 ms 写入 DOM，全量最慢 371 ms。输入框恢复焦点后，全量测试的 30 个按键均写入。快滚、历史分页和搜索定位在同一构建上通过。

### 验收平台

| 系统 | 状态 |
| --- | --- |
| macOS | Chromium 149 生产构建回放和浏览器验收 |
| Windows | — |
| Linux | — |

### 环境

本地生产 Web Shell 构建，使用本地模拟 daemon。回放计时使用浏览器可信键盘事件，投键时输入框有焦点且可编辑。

## 风险与范围

- 较小的预渲染范围会减少视口外提前挂载的行数。快滚验收采样不同高度消息行下的视口覆盖。
- 阅读历史、上拉旧页以及定位消息仍使用实际行高。改动沿用现有会话和配置格式。
- [English design](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/3c13c49bb20dcb1b2e90d3ef8b3df90720c4bb82/docs/design/2026-11-19-web-shell-replay-layout.md) · [简体中文设计](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/3c13c49bb20dcb1b2e90d3ef8b3df90720c4bb82/docs/design/2026-11-19-web-shell-replay-layout.zh-CN.md)

## 关联问题

—

</details>

prs.title: fix(memory): rebuild extraction indexes in the runtime
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The automatic memory extractor checks for duplicates and writes topic documents. The runtime rebuilds the matching user and project indexes using successful write receipts. The extractor can read the root indexes for deduplication. Its file tools reject writes to those indexes.

If a partially completed extraction has already saved a document, that document is included in the rebuilt index. When a project index repair fails, the next extraction retries it before inspecting new input. The history cursor stays at the last confirmed position until extraction completes.

## Why it's needed

The extractor currently asks the model to edit the indexes that the runtime already regenerates. That creates redundant tool calls and often requires additional model requests after the useful write has finished. A failed batch can also leave an already saved topic absent from the index.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Add a durable user preference and update an existing project memory. Check that the extractor only writes topic documents, that both runtime-generated root indexes point to those documents, and that a new session can recall them.
- Cancel a batch after a successful topic write or exhaust its turn budget. Check that the document is indexed and the history cursor still allows retry.
- Fail the project index rebuild once. On the next run, check that the runtime repairs the index even if the model detects an identical pre-existing topic and performs no new write.
- Try writing either root index directly or through a symlink from the extractor. Check that writes are denied and ordinary topic writes still succeed.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The targeted core suite passed all 179 tests on macOS. In a controlled replay at base commit `477dc9d214`, updating a topic took five model requests and included a failed index edit. Paired model measurements are tracked in the E2E evidence.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| --- | --- |
| macOS | Targeted core tests passed |
| Windows | Pending CI |
| Linux | Pending CI |

## Risk & Scope

The runtime now records a pending project index repair in the existing extraction cursor. Older cursor files work without migration. The change uses the extractor's existing permission boundary and keeps the model route, history input, and scheduling cadence.

[English design](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/2bdd1490f908f5f7671744f4ee8664ac1feb08fa/docs/design/auto-memory/runtime-owned-extraction-index.md) · [简体中文设计](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/2bdd1490f908f5f7671744f4ee8664ac1feb08fa/docs/design/auto-memory/runtime-owned-extraction-index.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Related to #13004.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 改动

自动提取器负责查重和写入主题正文。运行时根据成功写入的工具回执重建对应的用户和项目索引。提取器可以按需读取根索引查重，其文件工具会拒绝写入根索引。

如果一次未完成的提取已经保存正文，重建索引时会包含该正文。项目索引修复失败后，下次提取会先重试修复，再检查新输入。游标在提取完成前停留在上次确认的位置。

## 背景

提取器当前要求模型编辑运行时已经会重新生成的索引。这会增加工具调用，有时正文写成后还要再发起模型请求。一次失败的提取也可能让已保存的正文暂时无法从索引查到。

## 审阅测试计划

### 验证步骤

- 新增一条长期用户偏好，再更新一条已有项目记忆。确认提取器只写正文，由运行时生成的两个根索引都包含对应条目，新会话能够召回。
- 正文成功落盘后取消提取，或耗尽轮次上限。确认正文已进入索引，游标允许下次重新处理。
- 让项目索引重建失败一次。再次提取时，即使模型发现正文已经存在并且没有再写，也应先修复索引。
- 尝试由提取器直接或通过符号链接写根索引。确认索引写入被拒绝，普通正文仍能保存。

### 前后对照证据

macOS 上 179 项定向 Core 测试全部通过。基线 `477dc9d214` 的受控更新样本发起五次模型请求，其中有一次失败的索引编辑。真实模型配对数据另见端到端测试证据。

### 测试平台

| 平台 | 状态 |
| --- | --- |
| macOS | 定向 Core 测试通过 |
| Windows | 等待 CI |
| Linux | 等待 CI |

## 风险和范围

运行时在现有游标文件上记录待修复的项目索引。旧游标无需迁移。改动使用提取器现有的权限边界，沿用模型路由、历史输入和调度节奏。

[英文设计](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/2bdd1490f908f5f7671744f4ee8664ac1feb08fa/docs/design/auto-memory/runtime-owned-extraction-index.md) · [中文设计](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/2bdd1490f908f5f7671744f4ee8664ac1feb08fa/docs/design/auto-memory/runtime-owned-extraction-index.zh-CN.md)

## 关联 Issue

关联 #13004。

</details>

prs.title: feat(managed-agent): add external Shell worker profile and publication producer [17357 A/2]
prs.body:
Split from #17357 at source commit `510dc8a1d994331868f71ebb175bf4ebcb8e7219`; candidate A rebuilt on current main as `c8f4fb6e1eb91` (branch `split/17357-worker-and-producer-v2`). This is **[17357 A/2]** — the worker-side external foreground-Shell profile and the control-plane publication producer & HTTP capture transport, re-targeted directly onto current `main`. It supersedes #17473, whose base predated the Kubernetes/CSI archival: CSI logic is dropped with #17415, and the external-publication JSON reads now use `ManagedContextProtocol.parseCanonical` instead of the removed `ManagedCsiFilesProtocol`. #17474 (**[17357 B/2]**) wires the Broker dispatch/drain/close fences and Control Plane profile negotiation on top.

## What this PR does

Adds the two foundational halves of the external foreground-Shell lane (#15512 slice C) without altering existing placements:
- **CLI / Worker external-Shell profile & local capture routes**: admits `hosted-workspace-external-shell/1` and its capability digest (`EXTERNAL_SHELL_CAPABILITY_DIGEST`) on session-isolated registered external storage, adds `captureId` binding and horizon renewal (`/internal/managed-runtime/v2/publication:renew`) to `ManagedExternalPublication`, and retires the worker's local capture on its drained stop (`:stop-drained`) once every stream's empty EOF sequence has been acknowledged.
- **Control-plane publication producer & HTTP transport**: extracts `ToolPublicationEvidence` and `ToolPublicationSealManifest` from `ToolPublicationStore` / `ToolPublicationDataStore` (lowering `GLOBAL_MAX_LINES` from 2549 to 2483), adds the attested external publication HTTP calls to `HttpRuntimeTransport`, and lands `ExternalShellPublicationProducer`, which copies a worker's captured stdout/stderr blocks into the control plane's durable publication store, seals the manifest, and finishes the publication before acknowledging the worker's EOF sequences.

## Why it's needed

An externally provisioned worker holds no control-plane credential and cannot write directly into the control plane's publication store. By landing the worker's local capture routes, the publication-store collaborator extraction, and `ExternalShellPublicationProducer` in a standalone 31-file PR targeting `main` directly, both the TypeScript worker routes and the Java HTTP/store producer protocol can be reviewed and verified by CI independently of the Broker dispatch and Session close state machines in #17474 (**[17357 B/2]**).

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the worker protocol, publication producer, and class-size ratchet suites from `packages/managed-agent-server` on JDK 21:

```bash
cd packages/managed-agent-server
mvn -o -pl verification -am test \
  -Dtest=ExternalShellWorkerProtocolTest,ExternalShellProducerPublicationTest,ClassSizeRatchetTest
```

And the CLI worker unit tests from `packages/cli`:

```bash
cd packages/cli
npx vitest run src/serve/hosted-workspace-profiles.test.ts src/serve/managed-external-publication.test.ts src/serve/managed-runtime-tool-executor.test.ts
```

Expected:
- `ExternalShellWorkerProtocolTest` (9 tests) drives the real attesting HTTP transport against a worker process enforcing the channel rules: idempotent `begin`, forward-only horizon renewal, multi-block stdout/stderr copy, empty EOF acknowledgement, and `:stop-drained` refusal until EOF is acknowledged.
- `ExternalShellProducerPublicationTest` (5 tests) drives `ExternalShellPublicationProducer` end to end against real H2 `ToolPublicationStore` and `ToolPublicationDataStore`.
- `ClassSizeRatchetTest` passes with `ToolPublicationDataStore` lowered to 2483 and `ToolPublicationStore` lowered to 829.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A for UI — worker protocol and publication producer foundation with no TUI surface.

```text
ExternalShellWorkerProtocolTest       Tests run: 9, Failures: 0, Errors: 0
ExternalShellProducerPublicationTest  Tests run: 5, Failures: 0, Errors: 0
ClassSizeRatchetTest                  Tests run: 2, Failures: 0, Errors: 0
mvn -o test-compile                   BUILD SUCCESS (all 15 reactor modules)
```

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Local JDK 21 (`openjdk@21`) and Node.js 22 on macOS.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: `ExternalShellPublicationProducer` enforces a 65,536-block ceiling and requires every stream to end with an acknowledged empty EOF block before finishing the control-plane publication; any mismatch fails closed with a retryable `RuntimeBrokerException` rather than sealing a partial capture.
- Not validated / out of scope: Broker dispatch/cancel/reconcile/close wiring and Control Plane Session creation profile selection live in #17474 (**[17357 B/2]**); until B/2 lands, no Session can select `hosted-workspace-external-shell/1` through the control plane.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Existing placements and handle versions are unchanged.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/split/17357-worker-and-producer-v2/docs/design/2026-10-25-external-hosted-workspace.md) · [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/split/17357-worker-and-producer-v2/docs/design/2026-10-25-external-hosted-workspace.zh-CN.md) — §15 documents the external foreground-Shell boundary and settle rules.

## Linked Issues

Part of #15512 (phase 2, slice C). Split from #17357 (`[17357 A/2]`); supersedes #17473.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

自 #17357 的源码提交 `510dc8a1d994331868f71ebb175bf4ebcb8e7219` 拆分而来；候选 A 已在当前 main 上重建为 `c8f4fb6e1eb91`（分支 `split/17357-worker-and-producer-v2`）。本 PR 是 **[17357 A/2]** —— 包含 worker 侧外部前台 Shell profile 与控制面 publication producer 及 HTTP capture 传输层，直接以当前 `main` 为 base。本 PR 取代 #17473（其 base 早于 Kubernetes/CSI 归档）：CSI 逻辑随 #17415 一并放弃，外部 publication 的 JSON 解析改用 `ManagedContextProtocol.parseCanonical` 替代已删除的 `ManagedCsiFilesProtocol`。#17474 (**[17357 B/2]**) 在此基础上接入 Broker 派发/排空/关闭围栏与控制面 profile 协商。

## 这个 PR 做了什么

在不影响现有 placement 的前提下，落地外部前台 Shell 通道（#15512 slice C）的两个基础部分：
- **CLI / Worker 外部 Shell profile 与本地 capture 路由**：在 session 隔离的注册外部存储上准入 `hosted-workspace-external-shell/1` 及其 capability digest（`EXTERNAL_SHELL_CAPABILITY_DIGEST`），在 `ManagedExternalPublication` 中新增 `captureId` 绑定与租约续期路由（`/internal/managed-runtime/v2/publication:renew`），并在每条流的空 EOF 序列被确认后通过 `:stop-drained` 退役本地 capture。
- **控制面 publication producer 与 HTTP 传输层**：从 `ToolPublicationStore` / `ToolPublicationDataStore` 中抽离 `ToolPublicationEvidence` 与 `ToolPublicationSealManifest`（将全局类尺寸上限 `GLOBAL_MAX_LINES` 从 2549 降至 2483），在 `HttpRuntimeTransport` 中新增带鉴权的外部 publication HTTP 调用，并落地 `ExternalShellPublicationProducer` —— 将 worker 捕获的 stdout/stderr 数据块搬运至控制面持久化 publication 存储、写入 seal manifest 并完成 publication，随后才确认 worker 的 EOF 序列。

## 为什么需要它

外部提供的 worker 不持有控制面凭据，无法直接写入控制面的 publication 存储。将 worker 本地 capture 路由、publication 存储协作类抽离以及 `ExternalShellPublicationProducer` 拆分为直接面向 `main` 的 31 文件独立 PR 后，TypeScript 侧路由与 Java 侧 HTTP/存储 producer 协议可以独立于 #17474 (**[17357 B/2]**) 的 Broker 状态机进行评审并运行全量 CI。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

在 JDK 21 下从 `packages/managed-agent-server` 运行 worker 协议、publication producer 与类尺寸上限测试：

```bash
cd packages/managed-agent-server
mvn -o -pl verification -am test \
  -Dtest=ExternalShellWorkerProtocolTest,ExternalShellProducerPublicationTest,ClassSizeRatchetTest
```

并在 `packages/cli` 下运行 CLI worker 单元测试：

```bash
cd packages/cli
npx vitest run src/serve/hosted-workspace-profiles.test.ts src/serve/managed-external-publication.test.ts src/serve/managed-runtime-tool-executor.test.ts
```

预期行为：
- `ExternalShellWorkerProtocolTest`（9 个用例）通过真实鉴权 HTTP 传输层驱动遵循通道规则的 worker 进程：按执行幂等 `begin`、只进不退的租约续期、多块 stdout/stderr 搬运、空 EOF 确认，以及在 EOF 确认前拒绝 `:stop-drained`。
- `ExternalShellProducerPublicationTest`（5 个用例）基于真实 H2 `ToolPublicationStore` 与 `ToolPublicationDataStore` 端到端验证 `ExternalShellPublicationProducer`。
- `ClassSizeRatchetTest` 通过，`ToolPublicationDataStore` 降至 2483 行，`ToolPublicationStore` 降至 829 行。

### 证据（修改前 / 修改后）

N/A（无 UI 变更 —— 纯协议与存储 producer 基础层）。

prs.title: fix(core): retain arguments after redirects in permission rules
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Suggested shell rules retain arguments after redirections without granting every subcommand of the executable. For supported commands, `git > /dev/null push origin main` produces `Bash(git push *)` and an original-command rule when needed to cover the invocation. Saving the complete suggestions covers that invocation; unrelated reset/clean commands still need their own permission.

The producer verifies the suggested set against the splitting and matching path used by PermissionManager. If a selected executable segment cannot be covered, it returns an empty suggestion list. Enclosing command-string wrappers now also return no persistent suggestions: approving one `bash -c` invocation must not mint `Bash(bash *)`. Argument recovery remains on the rule-production path, in source order, following [the maintainer direction in #17001](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/17001#issuecomment-6816035580). `getArgumentNodes` and read-only classification retain their existing behavior.

## Latest review follow-up

Current head: [`61297cc0a8`](https://github.com/Afloat16/qwen-code/commit/61297cc0a8b70302d6a4f242d6ab4c7affae4925); verified tree: `107f4fd2675ffefd543c7ca5f7eda568029ecc90`.

This addresses both findings in [the latest maintainer review](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17372#issuecomment-6995195187):

- Transparent `time`, `timeout`, `env`, `sudo` and `nice` prefixes derive the scoped suggestion from their executable payload. The original invocation remains the literal fallback. Saving the suggestions for a prefixed `git push` covers that invocation and leaves a prefixed `git reset --hard` at `ask`, in both Bash and Monitor.
- ShellTool passes the original command to the suggestion producer, preserving an enclosing `bash -c` / `sh -c` boundary. Those confirmations offer no persistent rule; ordinary unwrapped compound commands retain their selected-subcommand filter.

The English and Chinese design notes also record the accepted conservative cost: an existing `Bash(find *)` grant does not automatically approve an unmodeled `find -exec` callback.

Validation for this follow-up:

- All **18 new regressions failed on the unchanged preceding production code**, then passed with the fix. An independent rerun also passed all 18.
- **1,775 tests passed in 10 complete related core files**, with no failures or skips, covering the producer, PermissionManager/parser, ShellTool and shared Monitor/SSH/cron consumers.
- Normal core build and complete core typecheck passed with a 4 GiB Node heap. Changed-file ESLint, Prettier, the normal pre-commit checks and diff checks passed. The published tree matches the checked tree.

On this exact head, [main CI run 44451154598](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/44451154598) has passed lint, the build, both Linux unit shards, both no-AK shards and the Linux test aggregate. Both Web Shell smoke shards and their aggregate have now passed; the main CI workflow is successful. The five separate TUI, Landlock, managed-loop, managed-gate and Web Shell Host workflows also passed, so all six workflows on this head are now successful. Skipped native macOS/Windows jobs are not execution evidence. The [fresh manual safety precheck](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17372#issuecomment-6999238225) and R4-1 bounded-analysis contract still require maintainer confirmation. The `9b4504184c` checks below remain historical.

## Previous CI follow-up (`9b4504184c`)

Previous head: [`9b4504184c`](https://github.com/Afloat16/qwen-code/commit/9b4504184c95ea2498e891ff7601bd69ac4cab86), a normal follow-up to `16ae1be2941`. The published tree is `2c417083c0b6e839c9ff7f0a02c69fdbcca99479`.

The three shell-boundary failures in the preceding [Linux shard 2](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/44256433665/job/134649294332) are corrected. An array assignment keeps its adjacent hash in the same word, preserving a later executable command; native Bash prints the marker after both `x=(a b)#c;` and its `&&` variant. Ordinary group comments retain their previous boundary. The literal `busybox echo` applet prints its arguments and remains an ordinary-argument control; other BusyBox dispatchers keep the conservative confirmation boundary.

- The unchanged boundary file reproduced **3 failures and 36 passing controls** on `16ae1be2941`, and now passes **39/39**.
- **3,243 tests pass in 21 complete related core files**, with no failures or skips, including the boundary, wrapper, compound-cwd and shell AST suites.
- Normal core build and complete core typecheck pass with a 4 GiB Node heap and sequential execution. Changed-file ESLint, Prettier and diff checks pass. Earlier default-heap/overlapping build attempts ended with resource exits 134/137; those attempts are retained separately from the successful final runs.
- Independent source review found no additional blocker in these two production changes. The English and Chinese design descriptions identify the narrow BusyBox echo boundary.

The preceding [Linux shard 1](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/44256433665/job/134649294289) separately reported 92 Web Shell provider assertions and 9 cleanup rejections. The provider source/test, Web Shell test configuration, SDK source and lockfile are unchanged from base `a84d0b985e`; the failure signatures overlap the existing main-CI report [#16191](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/16191). A local Web Shell probe did not reach its test because its SDK daemon build prerequisite was missing and the subsequent default-heap build exhausted memory; no local Web Shell result is claimed. All six workflows on `9b4504184c` completed successfully: [main CI](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/44267231735), [TUI](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/44267231823), [Web Shell Host](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/44267231567), [Landlock](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/44267231851), [managed loop](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/44267231684), and [managed gate](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/44267231608). Main CI passed its Linux unit shards, no-AK shards and Web Shell smoke shards. Native macOS/Windows jobs were skipped by that workflow and are not claimed as passing. The earlier Web Shell failure is historical; it did not recur on this head. The existing manual precheck and R4-1 contract confirmation remain separate maintainer decisions.

R4-1 remains open for maintainer confirmation of the bounded-analysis contract below.

## Previous R10 review follow-up

R10 head: [`16ae1be2941`](https://github.com/Afloat16/qwen-code/commit/16ae1be2941df49d3419e7b75f94da45faa85ebc), a normal follow-up to `04c4343271`. The published tree is `a03d9b88edf96b108043bc0919acfc0a5b8d0d55`.

| Review item | Change and boundary |
| --- | --- |
| R9-1, R10-1, R10-8: prefix payloads | Restrictive inspection keeps env options after assignments, resumes split-string parsing after a comment newline, and consumes timeout duration/options and env/time/sudo operands correctly. Explicit `--` and the real executable remain argv boundaries. Unsupported environment, namespace and output effects do not gain transparent grants. |
| R10-2: non-Bash cwd changes | Restore the shell-agnostic cd/pushd trigger alongside the Bash cwd tracker, so cmd/PowerShell classification cannot use the original directory after a directory-changing prefix. |
| R10-3: joined cwd paths | Retain up to 64 known reachable directories and their file operations. Divergence or truncation remains uncertain; an unresolved relative restriction forces confirmation. Child shells, callbacks and find execution clauses share this bounded state instead of expanding a subtree per directory. |
| R10-4: multiline heredoc headers | Continue a header across an unclosed single, double or ANSI-C quote, as well as a backslash-newline. A trailing `&&`, `||` or `|` still starts the heredoc body on the next physical line. |
| R10-5: env at the recursion limit | Keep the shared unwrap limit at four. At the limit, the final env argv receives static effect extraction without another recursive walk. Deeper unresolved execution remains a forced confirmation. |
| R10-6: group/comment boundaries | A hash after a completed ordinary group starts a comment; a hash still attached to a substitution/expansion word stays literal. Comment-local quotes cannot conceal a substitution on the next physical line. |
| R10-7: grouped background gates | Bare grouping parentheses are token boundaries, allowing the cron gate to see a backgrounding wrapper inside a group. The gate's existing refusal also survives preserving an unmodeled wrapper as the permission safety command. |
| R10-9: wrapper suggestions | Return no persistent suggestions for an enclosing command-string wrapper. Ordinary redirected git suggestions retain their real PermissionManager round trip. |
| R4-1: execution entrances | Add PATH/LD_PRELOAD/LD_LIBRARY_PATH, BusyBox dispatch, the reported argv launchers and a positive inert shell-option whitelist to the conservative grant boundary. Retain literal mapfile/readarray callback effects, including repeated `-C` and value-taking flags. Known effects still trigger explicit Read/Edit denies. |

Preserving an unmodeled wrapper must not hide existing Monitor restrictions on its inner command. A separate, bounded restrictive-only view retains inner deny/ask matching and rule relevance; it never uses an inner allow to authorize the outer invocation. The find follow-up also preserves directory-listing operations, execution-clause order and uncertain execdir/okdir directories. Reaching its recursion bound cannot turn an unexpanded payload into an allow.

### R4-1 contract for maintainer confirmation

The named unmodeled entrances now produce `ask` with `pmForcedAsk: true` when relevant file restrictions are present; adding a broad allow does not override that result. Known callback and other visible file effects retain their explicit deny. Opaque startup files, namespace changes and arbitrary external-program behavior do not expose enough information to attribute a definite file path from shell syntax alone. No file operation is invented to satisfy that assertion.

I am leaving R4-1 open for confirmation of this bounded contract, rather than claiming that the analyzer can emit a definite Read/Edit operation for every opaque program. The tests check the real permission helper result and the forced-ask flag, including Monitor, plus the existing automatic-mode forced-confirmation controls.

### R10 validation

- **2,372 tests passed in 17 complete affected core test files**, with no failures or skips, using the normal package Vitest configuration and global setup.
- **Passed:** normal core workspace build and `tsc --noEmit`, changed-file ESLint with zero warnings, Prettier for all 21 changed files, and diff checks. The final build, typecheck and whole-file test run were repeated after the find state/depth fix.
- Frozen root regressions initially produced **41 failures / 23 passing controls**. The completed root regression file now has **82 passing cases**. Prefix regressions initially produced **19 failures / 22 controls**; the final prefix/callback parser file has **60 passing cases**.
- Non-Bash cwd regressions initially produced **8 failures / 12 controls**, and all **20** now pass. The tests use real temporary Git configuration with controlled shell selection; they are not claimed as native Windows execution.
- Monitor restriction regressions initially produced **21 failures / 9 controls**; the final wrapper file has **35 passing cases**. Comment-boundary regressions initially produced **6 failures / 18 controls**, and all **24** now pass.
- Five isolated prefix mutations each triggered the intended failures; every source mutation was restored. Independent review additionally caught callback option operands, flags after `-c`, Monitor's restrictive payload view, and find resetting the shared state/depth. The final find cases cover **64 retained writes and 16 directory operations**, ordered repeated clauses, ordinary-find controls and both callers' forced confirmation after depth truncation.
- Harmless native probes used GNU coreutils 9.7, official uutils 0.10.0 and Bash marker files. GNU rejects the tested post-assignment env/post-duration timeout options and ends the tested split string at its comment; uutils executes the payload in those cases. The earlier GNU-only conclusion on `04c4343271` is superseded. The cross-implementation effect is retained conservatively; no protected-file fixture command was executed.
- Two final scoped source reviews found no additional Critical issue after the corrections. This is separate from the executed checks and the remaining R4-1 contract decision.

The results in this R10 section belong to `16ae1be2941`; its later CI failures and the current correction are recorded above. Local full CLI compilation and native Windows execution were not claimed for R10. Historical validation below keeps its original commit attribution.

<details>
<summary>Earlier R8 and R7 changes and validation</summary>

## Preceding R8 restriction follow-up

R8 head: [`2ba4b49d88`](https://github.com/Afloat16/qwen-code/commit/2ba4b49d8894c561b3ae5456ecc45611f544ca71), a normal follow-up to `0263003726`.

This addresses the active restriction findings in [R8](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17372#pullrequestreview-5941855049):

| Review item | Change and boundary |
| --- | --- |
| R8-1: an expanded argument suppresses a redirect restriction | An unavailable static view keeps a potentially applicable redirect restriction unresolved and requires confirmation. A static view with a different known target remains unrelated. |
| R8-3: heredoc bodies lose their delimiter | Quoted heredoc bodies are stripped before executable continuations are joined. Continued delimiter headers and the different continuation behavior of unquoted bodies have separate regressions. The following executable command remains visible to the operation tracker. |
| R8-5: unresolved file arguments bypass Read/Edit | Explicit file restrictions trigger confirmation for expanded arguments, including supported nested shell wrappers, bare pathname/brace expansions and named-home prefixes. Unknown paths stay unattributed; the tracker does not guess environment values. Quoted and escaped literal controls remain supported. |
| R8-6: bare home redirects disagree with the tracker | Only bare `~`/ `~/...` targets use the tracker's home directory. Quoted, escaped and partially quoted tilde prefixes remain literal, including adjacent redirects. Named-home targets stay unresolved. |
| Carried R4-1: additional execution entries | `source`, `.`, `trap` and `parallel` join the unmodeled-execution veto. This does not change source/dot cwd classification. No persistent grant is suggested for these entries. |
| Home-directory environment | `HOME` changes join the execution-affecting environment guard. Prefixes that clear HOME carry that uncertainty into the existing child-shell recursion, including nested or encoded payloads; ordinary env commands, absolute targets and quoted literal tilde controls remain supported. |

The preceding fixes for cwd success/failure flow, wrapper payloads, empty arguments, parent components and scoped comment handling are retained. The English and Chinese design notes under `docs/design/2026-11-17-shell-permission-rule-coverage[.zh-CN].md` are synchronized.

## Validation recorded for the preceding R8 head

[Exact-commit hosted validation](https://github.com/Afloat16/anti-rea-forge/actions/runs/44152320048/job/134283682199) checked out `2ba4b49d8894c561b3ae5456ecc45611f544ca71` with Node 24.22.1:

- **4,044 tests passed in 30 complete core test files**, covering all permission suites plus affected shell utilities, permission helpers, Shell and Monitor.
- **Passed:** normal core workspace build and typecheck, changed-file ESLint with zero warnings, repository Prettier and a clean diff.
- Replacing only the changed production files with the preceding implementation `0263003726`, rebuilding normally and keeping the new tests produced **64 expected assertion failures and 551 passing controls** across the four regression files. The check required a failure in every reported restriction family; collection errors did not count.
- Restoring the exact candidate, verifying a clean tree and rebuilding produced **615 passing tests in all four regression files**.

The validation workflow lives only on an isolated validation branch; no workflow or build-configuration changes were added to this PR.

These checks use the normal workspace build, TypeScript configuration, Vitest configuration and global setup. Permission fixtures inspect parser/tracker decisions; they do not execute their protected-file or destructive sample commands. Two focused source-review passes found no additional Critical issue in this follow-up's scope; that is separate from the executed checks above.

The [upstream checks](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17372/checks) remain the full integration gate. Complete CLI compilation, cross-platform behavior and broader integration are not claimed by that focused R8 validation.

<details>
<summary>Validation recorded for the preceding R7 head only</summary>

The prior head `0263003726e9a34f617e725492d9a0bdbd01f3e5` recorded 4,507 passing tests in 42 complete core files; 692 passing tests in five affected CLI files, with two existing skips; and 147 fixed permission scenarios against source and freshly built core JavaScript. Its normal core build/typecheck, schema generation, bundle, four startup checks and changed-file lint/format checks passed.

Those counts belong to the preceding head and do not validate the new R8 commit. The prior full CLI workspace build ended with exit 137, and its separate 4 GiB CLI typecheck exhausted the heap with exit 134; neither was counted as passing.

</details>


</details>

## Scope

- Existing settings and saved rules are not rewritten. Prefix/glob and legacy `:*` parsing remain. Additional redirect equivalences apply only to deny/ask; allow matching is not broadened.
- Path handling does not collapse `..`, resolve symlinks or call `realpath`. Exactly two leading slashes and quoted wildcard literals remain distinct. Unknown cwd and unresolved paths remain conservative.
- Ordinary comments resume after parameter expansion closes. Monitor comment/newline cases and unsupported groups/heredocs may still return `[]` and require confirmation. This does not claim general interpretation of arbitrary scripts or executable side effects.
- The malformed `/tmp/prot"ected` example has an unclosed quote; valid quoted spellings remain covered. The broader heredoc splitting report / #16870 and findings explicitly deferred by the review stay outside this focused restriction follow-up.

Refs #17001.


<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

### 最新评审修订

当前提交 `61297cc0a8` 修复最新维护者评审的两个问题：透明 time/timeout/env/sudo/nice 前缀从真实负载提取最小建议，并保留原调用的字面回退；ShellTool 将原始命令传给建议生成器，外层 bash/sh 命令字符串边界不再被提前剥离。Bash、Monitor 与真实确认对话框均验证同一 git push 可放行、同前缀的 git reset 仍要求确认，普通复合命令的已授权分段过滤保持。双语设计同时明确了 find 执行回调的保守确认代价。

固定新增回归在旧生产代码上为 **18 失败**，修复后及独立复跑均为 **18 通过**；10 个完整相关 Core 文件共 **1,775 项通过，零失败、零跳过**。正常 Core 构建、完整类型检查、变更文件 lint/格式、正常 pre-commit 与 diff 检查通过，发布树与已测树一致。当前提交的六条上游工作流已全部成功，仍需人工安全预检和 R4-1 有限分析契约确认；下方旧提交的 CI 与验证数字保留其原始归属。

### 前一轮 CI 修订（`9b4504184c`）

前一轮提交 `9b4504184c` 是 `16ae1be2941` 的正常后续提交，发布树为 `2c417083c0b6e839c9ff7f0a02c69fdbcca99479`。修复前一轮 Linux 第二分片的三个 shell 边界失败：数组赋值后的相邻 `#` 保留在同一个词中，不再隐藏后续实际执行的命令；普通命令组后的注释边界保持。字面的 `busybox echo` 只打印参数，恢复其普通参数控制用例，其余 BusyBox 分派器继续保守要求确认。

未修改断言的原边界文件在旧提交上为 **3 失败、36 个对照通过**，修复后 **39/39 通过**；21 个完整相关 Core 文件共 **3,243 项通过，零失败、零跳过**。使用 4 GiB Node 堆并串行执行的正常 Core 构建、完整类型检查，以及变更文件 lint、格式和 diff 检查均通过。之前默认堆或并行构建尝试出现资源退出码 134/137，未计为通过。两个生产改动已完成独立源码复核，双语设计同步说明了 BusyBox echo 的有限例外。

前一轮 Linux 第一分片另有 Web Shell provider 的 92 项断言失败和 9 项清理拒绝。其源码、测试、配置、SDK 源码与锁文件相对基线 `a84d0b985e` 均未改变，失败签名与既有主分支报告 [#16191](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/16191) 重合。本地 Web Shell 探针因缺少 SDK daemon 构建产物而未进入测试，随后默认堆构建耗尽内存，因此不声称有本地 Web Shell 测试结果。`9b4504184c` 的六条上游工作流全部成功：main CI、TUI、Web Shell Host、Landlock、managed loop 和 managed gate。main CI 的 Linux 单元测试、no-AK 与 Web Shell smoke 分片均通过；该工作流跳过的原生 macOS/Windows 作业不计为通过。旧 Web Shell 失败在当前提交上没有复现。既有人工预检与 R4-1 有限分析契约仍待维护者确认。

### 前一轮 R10 修订

前一轮 R10 提交 `16ae1be2941` 是 `04c4343271` 的正常后续提交，发布树为 `a03d9b88edf96b108043bc0919acfc0a5b8d0d55`。该轮修复 R9-1、R10-1 至 R10-9，并补齐 R4-1 所列执行入口的保守权限边界。

`env` 赋值后的选项、拆分字符串注释后的换行、`timeout` 时长后的选项，以及 env/time/sudo 的带值操作数，都保留可能执行的负载供限制规则检查。GNU coreutils 9.7 与 uutils 0.10.0 的真实行为不同：前者拒绝所测选项顺序或在注释结束拆分字符串，后者会执行负载。因此旧提交仅依赖 GNU 的结论已经更正，显式 `--` 与真实可执行文件之后的普通 argv 边界仍保留。

cwd 合并最多保留 64 个已知可达目录，已知文件效果继续触发 deny；分歧与截断保持不确定，不能自动放行相关限制。子 shell、callback 与 find 的执行子句共享状态和深度，不再重复扩展子树。递归上限仍为四；最后一层 env argv 可以做静态提取，更深未解析的执行保持强制确认。find 的目录操作、重复执行顺序与 execdir/okdir 未知目录保持，达到上限后的 Bash、Monitor 都验证为 `ask / pmForcedAsk: true`。

同时修复多行引号 heredoc 头、普通组后的注释边界、括号组内的后台执行扫描，以及非 Bash 的 cd/pushd 整体分类回退。外层 `bash -c` 等命令字符串包装不再产生可授权任意负载的持久建议；普通重定向 git 命令的真实权限往返保持。Monitor 单独保留内部命令的 deny/ask 匹配和规则相关性，内部 allow 不会授权整个包装命令。

R4-1 所列 PATH/动态链接环境、BusyBox、启动器及未知 shell 选项均加入保守守卫，已知 mapfile/readarray 回调保留真实文件效果。不透明启动文件、命名空间或任意程序不能仅凭 shell 语法推断确定文件路径；这些情况返回带强制标志的确认，而不是虚构操作。R4-1 线程保留开放，供维护者确认这个有限分析契约。

R10 的最终正常 Core 构建、完整类型检查、lint、格式与 diff 检查通过；17 个完整测试文件 **2,372 项通过，零失败、零跳过**。这些检查在最后的 find 修复后重新运行，发布树与已测树一致。固定旧源码回归、五类前缀变异、安全原生执行探针及两轮最终定点审查均已完成；不把受控非 Bash 测试说成原生 Windows 执行。这些 R10 数字属于 `16ae1be2941`；本轮验证见上方，历史 R8/R7 数字保持各自提交归属。

</details>

prs.body:
## What this PR does

Scan both supported SSE delimiters in a single forward pass, preserving complete frames and unfinished tails. When delimiters overlap, consume the first complete separator.

## Why it's needed

CRLF event batches repeatedly scan the remaining buffer for an LF-only separator. Large replay batches therefore grow quadratically and block consumers even though equivalent LF batches finish quickly.

## Latest review follow-up

[Commit `0831396083`](https://github.com/Afloat16/qwen-code/commit/08313960834d63c40a1f249131416846d2a30ffe) adds the requested generous **500 ms scan-only budget** to each existing 16,000-frame LF/CRLF test. Input construction and result assertions are outside the timed interval; all frame-order and tail checks remain.

A semantics-preserving mutation that repeatedly searches the full remaining buffer passes the content and overlapping-separator assertions but fails the new CRLF timing assertion at **2,783.80 ms**: **22 passed, 1 failed** across the two complete framing suites. Restoring the production source byte for byte gives **23 passed**. A separate three-run CRLF sample measured **35.30 / 10.60 / 2.61 ms** on this host. These are local regression measurements, not an end-to-end latency guarantee.

Changed-file lint/formatting, normal pre-commit checks and diff checks passed; the published tree is `8ee94e832fdb920cf5ae7e89e27429c8f4cc69e2`. This follow-up changes only the regression test. On this exact head, [main CI run 44451354678](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/44451354678) has passed lint, the build, both Linux unit shards, both no-AK shards, both Web Shell smoke shards and the Linux test aggregate. The final Web Shell smoke aggregate has also passed; all five workflows on this head are now successful. The separate TUI, managed-loop, managed-gate and Web Shell Host workflows passed. The latest review found no remaining findings; its approval was downgraded solely because CI was still running, and that pending-CI condition is now resolved. The older CI results below keep their original commit attribution.

中文：本次仅补充审查要求的性能回归断言，对现有 16,000 帧 LF/CRLF 用例单独测量扫描，宽松上限为 500ms，保留内容与尾部断言。语义相同的二次扫描变异仅在新 CRLF 时限断言失败（2,783.80ms，完整两文件 22 通过、1 失败）；逐字节恢复生产源码后为 23/23 通过。正常 lint、格式、pre-commit 与 diff 检查通过。当前提交的五条上游工作流现已全部成功；最新评审没有剩余 findings，此前仅因 CI 未结束而降级的审批条件现已解除。旧 CI 结果保留其原始提交归属。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Replay large LF-only, CRLF-only and mixed batches. Every frame should remain in order, and unfinished delimiters should remain buffered.
2. Check a CRLF separator followed by another newline. The first complete CRLF boundary should be consumed without merging neighboring events.
3. Compare increasing CRLF batch sizes. The parser should avoid the repeated full-suffix scans while ordinary LF throughput remains comparable.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The focused framing suites report **22 passed, 1 failed** on the unchanged base and **23 passed** with the change; the failing base assertion concerns an overlapping delimiter boundary. An independent same-host sample measured 16,000 CRLF events at approximately **1,663 ms before / 6.38 ms after**, with LF controls at **4.39 / 4.33 ms**. Frame counts and unfinished tails were also checked. These are local framing measurements, not a network or end-to-end latency guarantee. Changed-file lint, formatting, normal commit hook and diff checks pass.

The unchanged full core build was killed with status 137, and a bounded-heap retry exhausted memory with status 134. The full repository preflight is not claimed as passed. This PR preserves the focused evidence while upstream checks evaluate the proposed commit.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| --- | --- |
| 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ Not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ Focused tests and independent reproduction |

### Environment

Node.js 24.22.1 on Linux, repository-pinned dependencies.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: The scanner must choose the first complete delimiter and preserve tail bytes; focused mixed and overlapping-boundary controls cover those cases.
- Not validated / out of scope: Full repository preflight, real daemon network performance and native macOS/Windows execution remain unverified.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: No public API or wire-format change.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #17561.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本次修改

一次向前扫描同时识别两种 SSE 分隔符，保留完整事件及不完整尾部。分隔符重叠时，消费最先完整出现的分隔符。

## 修改原因

CRLF 事件批次原先反复扫描剩余缓冲区寻找 LF-only 分隔符，使大型回放呈二次增长并阻塞调用方，而等价 LF 批次很快完成。

## 审查者验证计划

### 验证方式

1. 回放大型 LF、CRLF 和混合批次。全部事件应按顺序保留，不完整分隔符应继续缓冲。
2. 检查 CRLF 分隔符后紧接另一个换行的情况。应消费第一个完整 CRLF 边界，避免合并相邻事件。
3. 比较逐渐增大的 CRLF 批次，确认不再反复扫描完整后缀，同时普通 LF 性能保持相近。

### 修改前后证据

定向分帧测试在未修改基线上为 **22 通过、1 失败**，修改后为 **23 通过**；基线失败断言对应重叠分隔符边界。独立同机样本中，16,000 个 CRLF 事件约为 **修改前1,663毫秒、修改后6.38毫秒**，LF 对照约为 **4.39 / 4.33毫秒**；同时检查了事件数量和不完整尾部。这些是本地分帧测量，未宣称网络或端到端时延保证。修改文件 lint、格式、正常提交 hook 及 diff 检查通过。

未修改的完整 core 构建以状态137终止，限制堆内存的重试以状态134耗尽内存，未将全仓 preflight 报告为通过。本 PR 保留定向证据，等待上游检查评估拟提交版本。

### 测试平台

| 系统 | 状态 |
| --- | --- |
| 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ 定向测试及独立复现 |

### 环境

Linux，Node.js 24.22.1，仓库固定版本依赖。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：扫描必须选择第一个完整分隔符并保留尾部字节；混合及重叠边界对照覆盖这些情况。
- 未验证或不在范围内：完整全仓 preflight、真实 daemon 网络性能及原生 macOS/Windows 执行尚未验证。
- 破坏性变更或迁移：不改变公开 API 或协议。

## 关联问题

修复 #17561。

</details>

## Previous hosted CI follow-up

[Qwen Code CI run 44088338813](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/44088338813) built the current head successfully and passed lint/static checks and Linux shard 2/2. In shard 1/2, the SDK test phase passed **37 files / 1,638 tests**. That job failed later in the separate standalone-runtime check: downloading a runtime archive timed out after retries. The failure originates in the archive fetch, not a reported assertion failure in this PR's affected suite. That earlier run remains failed because of the download timeout. This PR is now ready for review. The new run's current merge-gate results are recorded below.

## Previous CI status (`a2e7d6a`)

For preceding head `a2e7d6a`, the required Lint & Static job in [run 44247846545](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/44247846545) failed in the unchanged CI cleanup helper's argv/cwd fixture: both attempts omitted PID 101, ending with 1,010 passed and 1 failed. ESLint, formatting and the preceding static checks passed. The deterministic fixture/ancestor-PID collision reproduction and its limits are recorded in [#17694](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/17694).

A focused helper-test fix is available as [97b221d](https://github.com/Afloat16/qwen-code/commit/97b221d5aa7dff8c7eee5c4c82e6dc4851089d5f). Its [dedicated Linux / Node 22 validation](https://github.com/Afloat16/anti-rea-forge/actions/runs/44254329665) passed the complete 14-test helper suite, normal workspace build, DEV bundle, workspace/integration typechecks and changed-file formatting. The production cleanup script is unchanged. The fix is recorded under #17694 while the contributor PR limit is full. This upstream required check remains failed; the dedicated helper validation does not replace it.

prs.title: test(core): cover last prompt invalidation after turn deletion
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds coverage for deleting the latest user turn from a persisted conversation. The test keeps the earlier turn, deletes the later one, and checks that the recorder invalidates the last-prompt timestamp for the same session.

## Why it's needed

A consumer may already have cached the timestamp of the deleted question. A transcript rewrite must tell it to recompute that value. The existing deletion tests could pass if that notification went missing.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the message-group deletion suite. Removing only the notification after the transcript rewrite should make the new case fail at the observer assertion. Restoring the notification should leave the first message group intact and produce exactly one invalidation for the session.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A for UI. With the notification removed locally, the observer received zero calls and the new case failed. After restoration, 14 tests passed. One pre-existing POSIX file permissions case skips Windows.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| --- | --- |
| Windows | Focused suite and negative control passed verification |
| macOS | Not run |
| Linux | Not run locally |

## Risk & Scope

A test using a temporary transcript and the real recorder. This covers item 5 of the follow-up. Other session-sorting and cost questions remain open.

## Linked Issues

Refs #16584.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

### 改动与动机

新增删除会话中最新用户回合的回归测试。测试保留较早的回合，删除较新的回合，并检查记录器是否通知观察者，使同一会话的最后提问时间失效。消费者可能仍持有已删除问题的时间戳，而现有测试无法发现这条通知消失。

### 评审验证

运行消息组删除测试。仅移除重写会话记录后的通知，新用例应在观察者断言处失败。恢复通知后，先前的消息组仍应存在，观察者应收到一次针对该会话的失效通知。

本次无界面对比。Windows 上移除通知后观察者收到零次调用，新用例按预期失败。恢复后 14 个用例通过，已有的 POSIX 文件权限用例在 Windows 上跳过。未在 macOS、Linux 本地运行。

### 范围

仅增加使用临时会话文件和真实记录器的测试，覆盖 #16584 的第 5 项。其余排序和开销问题仍待处理。

</details>

prs.title: fix(core): seed side-records-only sessions and close the artifact-summary residuals
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Closes the six below-Critical residuals the review of #17518 recorded as deferred in its final round, in one pass:

- **Side-records-only sessions now gain a count on first open, through both restore funnels.** Artifacts can be registered before the first prompt; such a transcript holds only side records, so the load path returned at the empty-conversation early return before the sidecar seed ever ran, and the session list showed no count until the first durable artifact event stamped one. The seed now runs before that early return and rebuilds from the whole transcript for the side-records-only shape — the same shape predicate the library mutation guard already accepts, now extracted into one shared helper so the sites cannot drift. The seed fires only for a transcript that reconstructs at least one message: metadata-bearing side-records sessions (the production shape — every daemon session carries `session_source`) gain the count on first open, while a pure artifact-only transcript, which no restore path can open (`loadSession` undefined, projection undefined), honestly gets no sidecar — a count there would advertise a set no cold open can deliver. The load funnel dispatches on a real conversation turn (`messages.some((m) => m.type !== 'system')`): creation-time metadata reconstructs messages too and the raw records are unvalidated, so neither `messages.length` nor the raw-array shape decides "has a conversation"; only a user/assistant/tool_result turn takes the uncapped seed (its read is the load itself, and the embedded restore snapshot must not depend on the sidecar cap). Everything else goes through one shared helper that owns the size probe, the auxiliary read, ownership, the shape gate and the seed: the shape gate states the property — every record is system metadata, no conversation turns — instead of enumerating subtypes, so every creation-time record (`session_source`, `session_model`, titles, …) keeps it true; it refuses a mixed raw array carrying a validator-dropped record, and the helper refuses a zero-message reconstruct — seeding either from an empty active set would heal a correct count to zero. The read is capped at the same 64 MiB as the library mutation read with the same inclusive boundary (exactly 64 MiB seeds, above skips, a failed size probe skips). The size and shape gates are sidecar-count policies only: when the helper declines (an oversized journal, or rewound-away conversation records beside a metadata-only active chain), the load funnel falls back to a payload-only rebuild so the restore payload still carries the active-branch artifacts while the sidecar stays untouched. The daemon/ACP funnel reads selectively via `readRestoreProjection` and never calls `loadSession`. For a defined projection with an empty apiHistory it counts exactly the set that projection delivers (`runtime.artifactSnapshot.artifacts` filtered by the shared restorable predicate) and heals an existing sidecar to that count, under the same authority gates as the load seed (an incomplete read — keyed on `sourceReadComplete`, the same signal the load seed gates on rather than the broader `sourcesUnavailable`, which also flags a damaged sources snapshot that does not narrow delivery — a history gap, or a damaged artifact journal keeps the correct count). One delivered-set definition spans all writers: the side-record selector includes every artifact record when the transcript never held a conversation turn, so the projection delivery, the load rebuild, the recorder stamp and the removal recount agree; a file with conversation records anywhere (even rewound away) keeps the active-segment rule. It pays no auxiliary read at all; a missing projection is not a restore candidate. Sessions with a conversation keep the selective read's zero-extra-I/O contract (pinned by a read spy) and are not seeded on the daemon funnel — their count arrives via the recorder stamp and the CLI load funnel, a pre-existing #17518 limitation for daemon-only legacy conversation sessions tracked as a follow-up.
- **Conflict discard witnessed in the realistic shape.** The existing conflict tests gave the kept side its own sidecar; two new cases cover the kept-side-absent (legacy) shape and pin that the dropped count is discarded, never transferred.
- **Per-session pending-restore keying witnessed.** A new bridge test loads two sessions on one shared channel, gates one restore mid-repopulation, and pins that only the restoring session's row carries the marker while the settled session keeps its count.
- **Widened restorable predicate witnessed on the removal path.** A new cold-removal case carries a non-snapshot published `file:` locator and pins that the survivor recount excludes it (the seed path already had this witness).
- **Gap-journal comment corrected to the verified arithmetic.** The comment claimed the rebuild undercounts to 2 of 3; a probe against the fixture's own exported predicates shows the active branch is just the orphan leaf `user-2`, so the preceding event's parent `user-1` is off it and only the orphan event (parented to the active leaf) is selected — the rebuild sees 1 of 3, with no warning. The test assertion is unchanged — `gaps.length` alone refuses the seed.
- **Design inventory completed.** The ACP session/list projection file joined "Files affected"; the seed decision and the validation plan record the side-records-only coverage and the new witnesses (both languages).

## Why it's needed

#17518 shipped the session-list artifact count with a best-effort derived sidecar. Its final review round recorded these six items as deferred under the convergence posture (no Critical open). Five are documentation/comment/test-coverage gaps; one is a small functional gap: a valid, listable session shape that never received the first-open seed the design promises. Fixing them together keeps the count's contract — "the sidecar describes what a cold open restores, seeded on first open" — true for every side-records-only transcript shape the library guard accepts (conversation-bearing sessions keep their existing recorder-stamp and CLI-load seeding).

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Register artifacts on a fresh session before sending any prompt, close it, remove its summary file if present, then open it from the session list: the row should carry the restorable count after that first open even though the session has no conversation. A session with a prompt behaves exactly as before. Conflict resolution (archive/unarchive with a competing transcript) must leave a kept side that had no summary file without one — the dropped count is discarded, and the next open regenerates it.

Focused suites (from each package directory; Node >= 22):

```bash
cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/services/sessionService.artifact-summary-sidecar.test.ts src/services/session-artifact-library.test.ts src/services/session-artifact-persistence.test.ts
cd packages/acp-bridge && npx vitest run src/bridge.test.ts -t 'pending-restore|restoring session|partial count|rewind restore'
```

### Evidence

Mutation witnesses M56–M87 (conflict count transfer, channel-wide pending marker, removal-path kind narrowing, projection gate hoist, property-gate regression to the subtype allowlist, cap drop, cap boundary flip, load-dispatch all-helper / all-uncapped, stat-failure skip drop, load partial-read threading drop, helper empty-message refusal drop, conversation-turn dispatch regression, projection defined-gate revert, projection restorable-filter drop, projection heal-rule drop, selector metadata-alignment drop, projection authority-gate drop, read-completeness conjunct drop, warnings conjunct drop, reader warnings-threading drop, damaged-sources gate regression revert, historyGaps conjunct drop, payload-fallback drop, payload-fallback routed through the seed write; retired with reasons: M54 seed position no longer load-bearing, M55/M61 composition/allowlist superseded, M59 gate direction flipped — M75 covers, M60 composition drop semantically equivalent after the selector alignment, M69 superseded by M74, M71/M72 helper empty-records/ownership guards are defense-in-depth both funnels pre-check, M80 sourcesUnavailable conjunct replaced by sourceReadComplete — M84 covers) each red the paired case; sha256-verified restores; cumulative 80/80 (round-8 batch 13: 9/9 gate mutations re-anchored to sourceReadComplete; round-9 batch 14: 2/2 payload-fallback witnesses). The gap-comment arithmetic was probed against the fixture's own exported predicates before rewording (1 of 3: the orphan leaf is the active branch, the preceding event's parent is off it, no warning). Real-daemon verification on the production shapes: a session created with `sourceType` (transcript carries `session_source`, no user record), and a session whose create+attach persisted a `session_model` record before any prompt — artifacts registered before the first prompt, closed and stripped of the sidecar, gain the count on a cold `session/load` through the daemon projection funnel (sidecar absent before, count after, list row carries it); the click-time browser arm still passes.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the seed now runs for transcripts with no conversation; it stays best-effort and gated (complete read, no history gap, no disqualifying warnings), and never creates a sidecar for an artifact-free session (zero count only heals an existing one).
- Not validated / out of scope: macOS/Windows not tested locally.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## 本 PR 做了什么

一次性关闭 #17518 最后一轮评审记录为延后的六条低于 Critical 的残留：

- **side-records-only 会话经两个恢复漏斗首次打开即获得数量。** 产物可在首个 prompt 之前注册；这种 transcript 只有侧记录，load 路径在空对话早退处返回，sidecar 播种从未执行，会话列表直到首个 durable 产物事件盖章才显示数量。播种现在早退之前执行，并对 side-records-only 形状从整份 transcript 重建——与库变更守卫已接受的形状判定相同，现提取为共享助手，各处不会漂移。播种只对能重建出至少一条消息的 transcript 生效：带元数据的 side-records 会话（生产形状——每个 daemon 会话带 session_source）首开获得数量；纯 artifact-only transcript 没有任何恢复路径能打开（loadSession undefined、投影 undefined），诚实状态是不写 sidecar——在那里写计数等于展示冷打开永远交付不了的集合。load 漏斗按真正对话轮次分派（messages.some(m => m.type !== 'system')）：创建期元数据也重建出消息、原始记录未校验，所以 messages.length 与原始数组形状都不能判定「有对话」；只有 user/assistant/tool_result 轮次走无上限播种（读取就是 load 本身，内嵌快照不依赖 sidecar 上限）。其余一律走共享助手（尺寸探测、辅助读取、归属、形状门、播种）：形状门陈述属性——每条记录都是 system 元数据、无对话轮次——而非枚举子类型，拒绝携带校验器丢弃记录的混合原始数组；助手拒绝零消息重建——从空活跃集播种会把正确计数治愈成零。读取与库变更读取同样 64 MiB 上限、同样包含边界（正好上限播种、超过跳过、探测失败跳过）。尺寸门与形状门只是 sidecar 计数策略：助手拒绝时（超上限 journal，或元数据活跃链旁存在 rewind 弃去的对话记录）load 漏斗回退到只构建载荷的重建，恢复载荷仍携带活跃分支产物而 sidecar 保持不变。daemon/ACP 漏斗经 readRestoreProjection 选择性读取、从不调用 loadSession。对「投影定义且 apiHistory 为空」，计数该投影实际交付的集合（runtime.artifactSnapshot.artifacts 经共享可恢复谓词过滤）并把已有 sidecar 治愈到该计数，且受与 load 播种相同的权威门约束（读取不完整——键控 sourceReadComplete，与 load 播种同一信号，而非更宽的 sourcesUnavailable（后者还会标记不收窄交付的损坏 sources 快照）、历史缺口、损坏 journal 保持正确计数）。所有写者共用一个交付集合定义：transcript 从未有过对话轮次时 selector 纳入全部 artifact 记录，投影交付/load 重建/recorder 盖章/删除重计一致；任何位置存在对话记录（即使 rewind 弃去）都保持活跃段规则。完全不付出辅助读取；投影缺失不是恢复候选。有对话会话保持选择性读取的零额外 I/O 契约，且不在 daemon 漏斗播种——其计数来自 recorder 盖章与 CLI load 漏斗，这是仅经 daemon 的 legacy 对话会话的 #17518 既有限制，作为跟进项跟踪。
- **冲突丢弃在真实形状下有见证。** 既有冲突测试给 kept 侧自己的 sidecar；新增两例覆盖 kept 侧无 sidecar（legacy）形状，钉住 dropped 计数被丢弃而非转移。
- **恢复中标记按会话键控有见证。** 新 bridge 用例在同一共享通道加载两个会话，闸住其中一个恢复的中途，钉住只有恢复中会话的行带标记，已落定会话保留计数。
- **放宽的可恢复谓词在删除路径有见证。** 新冷删除用例携带无快照 published file: 定位符，钉住幸存者重计将其排除（播种路径已有此见证）。
- **gap 日志注释改为实证算术。** 原注释称重计少计到 2/3；用夹具自己的导出谓词探针表明活跃链只有孤儿叶 user-2，前一个事件的父 user-1 不在链上、只有挂在活跃叶下的孤儿事件被选中——重建看到 1/3，无警告。测试断言不变——仅 gaps.length 就拒绝播种。
- **设计清单补全。** ACP session/list 投影文件加入「涉及文件」；播种决策与验证计划记录 side-records-only 覆盖与新见证（双语）。

## 为什么需要

#17518 以尽力而为的派生 sidecar 发布会话列表产物数量。其最后一轮评审在收敛姿态下把这六条记为延后（无未决 Critical）。五条是文档/注释/测试覆盖缺口；一条是小功能缺口：一个合法、可列出的会话形状从未获得设计承诺的首开播种。一并修复让计数契约——「sidecar 描述冷打开实际恢复的集合，首开播种」——对库守卫接受的每种 side-records-only transcript 形状都成立（有对话会话保持既有 recorder 盖章与 CLI load 播种）。

## 评审测试计划

在新会话上先注册产物、不发任何 prompt，关闭后删除其摘要文件（如有），再从会话列表打开：即使没有对话，该行也应在首开后的列表里携带可恢复数量。有 prompt 的会话行为完全不变。冲突解决（archive/unarchive 遇竞争 transcript）必须让原本无摘要文件的 kept 侧保持无文件——dropped 计数被丢弃，下次打开再生。

## 风险与范围

播种现在对无对话的 transcript 也执行；仍为尽力而为且受门控（完整读取、无历史缺口、无失格警告），绝不为无产物会话新建 sidecar（零计数只治愈已有）。macOS/Windows 未本地测试。无破坏性变更。

## 关联

#17518 的跟进（其最后一轮评审的延后残留）。

</details>
